jobs.title: Design Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **The Role**



As a **Design Program Manager** at Everlaw, you'll establish the operating system for our growing product design team, bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to how we design AI\-powered litigation tools. As our first dedicated Design Program Manager, you'll absorb operational friction and cross\-functional complexity so product designers can focus entirely on craft, quality, and solving complex user workflows.


**This is a full\-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**


#### **What you'll do**


* Own the design operating model for planning and delivery — define how design work is estimated, sequenced, and handed off, and maintain the system that makes dependencies and timeline risk visible before they become escalations.
* Define design readiness criteria and coordinate pre\-launch quality reviews to ensure shipped features meet high standards for craft, responsiveness, accessibility, and edge cases.
* Own the working interfaces between Design, Product Management, Engineering, User Research, and Technical Writing — define how scope is agreed, how dependencies are tracked, and where conflicts get decided, so those questions have a standing answer instead of being renegotiated per project.
* Build and champion lightweight design operations rhythms, frameworks, and templates—such as design briefs and critique structures—to streamline team workflows.
* Manage design resourcing and bandwidth tracking to inform staffing decisions, highlight capacity constraints, and help leadership plan for future team growth.
* Own how design's work is represented to the business — build and maintain the reporting layer (capacity, throughput, readiness) that lets product and executive leadership plan against design, rather than assembling narrative updates each cycle.

#### **About You**


* You have at least 5 years of experience in Design Program Management or Design Operations supporting product design teams in complex, enterprise B2B SaaS or data\-heavy environments.
* You excel at balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, steering teams through ambiguity with structure, clear prioritization, and empathy.
* You've built and scaled lightweight design operations frameworks, delivery plans, and resource tracking processes without stifling creative momentum.
* You bring excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to translate design progress and complex trade\-offs into business\-relevant narratives for leadership.
* You bring a strong understanding of user\-centered design methodologies, modern UX workflows, and tools like Figma.
* You have experience working with project tracking tools like Jira or emerging AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Design).
* You operate with a low\-ego, highly collaborative style, finding genuine fulfillment in making design teams visible and successful.
* You are authorized to work in the United States without restrictions. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring F\-1 visas, including OPT, for this role.


Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.


### **The Team — Product**



The Product team shapes products used by everyone from document reviewers and corporate teams to government attorneys and law firm partners, each with distinct needs across a broad and complex domain. The team brings together user insight, market context, business priorities, design, and technical feasibility to decide what Everlaw builds and why. This work turns deeply capable technology into intuitive experiences and helps define the next era of legal work.


### **Total Rewards \& Benefits**



The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $178,000\. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.


#### **Health \& well\-being**


* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance

#### **Financial rewards**


* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long\-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

#### **Growth \& everyday perks**


* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company\-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning \& development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices

### **About Everlaw**



When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.



We're the kind of place that's ranked \#1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career\-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upsi

jobs.description:
***Collaborative people. Progressive builders.***


Consistently recognized as a best workplace, and for our commitment to safety, sustainability, and community partnerships, BNBuilders hires the very best in the construction industry and strives to create an environment that encourages innovation, responsibility, and client satisfaction. If you are looking to be a part of an open, supportive team and receive exciting challenges that promote personal and professional growth, look no further than BNBuilders!

 **JOB SUMMARY:**


The Self\-Perform Project Manager provides operational and financial management support for the self\-perform projects. This role will be the main liaison between the Drywall and General Contractor Project Teams throughout the duration of the project(s).

 **SALARY RANGE:** $140,000 \- $180,000 annually

 **BENEFITS:**

* Group medical, vision, and dental insurance, including a choice of two benefit plans \- a PPO plan and a High Deductible/ Health Savings Account plan with company contribution to HSA.
* Company\-paid short and long\-term disability plans, group life insurance, and AD\&D plans.
* Untracked/unmeasured vacation.
* Sick leave accrued at 1 hour of sick leave for every 30 hours worked with an annual carryover of 80 hours.
* 9 paid holidays each year.
* Paid parental leave.
* Annual discretionary bonus based on company profitability and your manager's assessment of your performance.
* A 401(k) savings plan under which BNB matches the first 3 percent of your deferral with a 100% match and the next two percent with a 50% match for a total matching contribution of 4% of your pay. You are immediately 100% vested in all contributions (including BNB match). We provide both traditional (pre\-tax) and Roth (post\-tax) contribution options.
* We are proud to be an employee\-owned company. This means you get an ownership stake in BNB through a benefit called an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). It's 100% company\-funded and is invested in BNBuilders stock. You can participate in this long\-term plan after you complete 1 year of service (with at least 1,000 hours).
* Vehicle/Vehicle allowance, fuel card, and toll pass.

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Exercise general supervision of multiple job sites to monitor and manage projects during each phase of construction; including but not limited to pre\-construction, construction, closeout, and post\-construction.
* Create and execute project work plans and makes appropriate revisions to meet changing needs.
* Identify resources needed and assigns individual responsibilities.
* Manage day\-to\-day operation aspects of a project and scope.
* Prepare and manage change orders.
* Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.
* Develop cost\-effective plans and schedules for completion of projects following a logical pattern for utilization of resources.
* Responsible for ensuring that construction activities move according to predetermined schedule and project profitability forecast, monitoring the progress of construction activities on a regular basis and holding regular status meetings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all pertinent information is provided; proactive communication with field leaders on bid productions, RFI’s, and scope changes and maintains consistent communication throughout the project.
* Maintain strict adherence to the budgetary guidelines, quality, and safety standards.
* Proactively raise issues with the Team that may prevent flow and production.
* Meet with the Team as required to review change orders, roadblocks, production tracking, RFI’s, etc.
* Assist and mediate issues in the field. Document solutions, agreements and/or direction.
* Project accounting functions including managing the budget and preparing monthly project cost projections.
* Submit monthly billings for self\-performs scopes.
* Approve and reconcile vendor invoices.
* Negotiate and advocate for safety, quality, and production.
* Promote strong team morale.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\+ years or more of experience in the commercial drywall industry.
* Proven ability to coach and develop others and possess a team player mentality.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Detail\-oriented, deadline/goal\-driven.
* Ability to communicate effectively with team and clients.

  



**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:***The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  

Capable of traversing over construction\-type terrain when under development; moving through the construction site and the materials in place for use on the site; climbing ladders and temporary stairways; conducting visual inspections of quality of construction and materials being used in construction. Conduct jobsite walks to ensure successful project completion. Conduct jobsite walks to identify and eliminate safety hazards.

 **WORK ENVIRONMENT:***The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

  

BNB believes in collaboration, team\-building, and a strong supervisor/employee relationship. To accomplish this, the duties of this role are not performed in a remote capacity, and we expect that all employees will complete work in an office/job site setting.

  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at the job site. The noise level in the work environment and job site can be loud.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Defense Innovation
jobs.description:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.  

  

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

**About the Position**
======================



Dexis Professional Services (Dexis) is seeking a Contract Program Manager (PM) who will be responsible for the management and oversight of contract performance supporting the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU). The PM will provide management, direction, administration, quality assurance, and leadership of the execution of a task order (TO), including assigning tasks to contractor personnel, supervising ongoing technical efforts, and managing overall TO performance. The PM shall be responsible for the quality and efficiency of the TO, including technical issues and business processes. The PM will retain the authority to make decisions for Dexis in response to Government issues, concerns, and comments, as well as be proactive in alerting the Government to potential contractual, programmatic, and resource limitation issues.



The Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) facilitates collaborative partnerships between the Department of War (DoW), venture\-backed technology companies, and other non\-traditional innovation communities to expand the national security innovation base and address national security challenges. Doing so enables the DoW to leverage its unique acquisition process, reducing procurement timelines, and accelerating the integration of commercial solutions into defense operations. The DIU enterprise encompasses expertise, capabilities, and relationships across several commercial technology areas; public and private sectors; academia; and other communities of interest both United States (U.S.)\-based and internationally.



The PM will oversee a contract providing back\-office support services for DIU, so DIU can meet its objectives of accelerating the identification, acquisition, prototype, and transition of stable commercial technologies across the DoW, thus, delivering innovation at commercial speeds and greater scale with an emphasis on solutions most effective in a joint\-warfighting environment. The contract will provide support in the areas of information technology (IT), security and facilities, contracting and acquisitions, program management support, strategic communications, Congressional affairs, resource management, human resources, office of the general counsel, and records management.



The position requires an active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and will be based in Mountain View, CA at DIU's headquarters location with flexibility to travel to other DIU sites including within the National Capital Region. This position is contingent upon contract award.


**Responsibilities**
====================


* Oversee contract execution, ensuring compliance with contract objectives.
* Manage relationships with the client.
* Lead a large, geographically dispersed and multidisciplinary team, ensuring collaboration, coordination, and clear internal team communication.
* Ensure deliverables, products, services, and personnel meet government needs and expectations.
* Provide innovative approaches to team management.
* Provide technical support, leadership, and creation of processes in execution of the contract.
* Lead quality assurance and technical excellence of work on the contract and team; ensure deliverables and products are delivered timely and of quality acceptable to both the client and Dexis.
* Identify and mitigate schedule, performance, technical, and financial risks.
* Conduct cost monitoring and variance analysis.

**Qualifications**
==================


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
* At least five (5\) years of program management experience within the last ten (10\) years supporting large staffing efforts or projects of similar scope and complexity for the DoW, including support for operations, information management, and innovation of technologies.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams, managing schedules, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and supporting senior government stakeholders, preferably at DIU.
* Experience supporting DIU enterprise support functions and organizational operations, including with familiarity of contract support across the organization.
* Experience implementing and utilizing program management tools and software solutions.
* A current Project Management Institute (PMI) Project Management Professional or Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification.
* Exceptional client relationship management and executive communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited college/university.
* 10 years of experience managing DoW projects of similar scope and complexity.
* Private\-sector experience working with defense technology companies, nontraditional defense contractors, venture\-backed firms, or organizations supporting the defense innovation ecosystem.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with senior government, military, industry, and acquisition stakeholders associated with the DIU enterprise.
* Familiarity with the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU), defense acquisition pathways, commercial technology transition, and public\-private partnership models.

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in program management.
* 7 years of experience in leadership roles with/without direct reports.
* Experience leading technical programs in data centers or networking technologies.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience managing cross\-functional/team projects.
* 10 years of experience in a formal technical program management role.
* 10 years of experience working in a technological field with rapid rates of technology change.
* 10 years of experience demonstrating capabilities to influence across a broad, cross\-functional organization.
* Familiarity with network planning and engineering, including data center network engineering in complex environments.
* Strong knowledge of qualifications of network deployments, optical systems, and machine learning infrastructure.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Server Operations team monitors the physical and network infrastructure behind Google’s technology and holds responsibility for keeping the servers, networks, and logistics processes in Google’s global fleet of data centers running smoothly and efficiently.


Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a member of Fleet Management at Google, you will develop relationships, both internally and externally, and connect with internal customers and partner teams to develop an understanding of their business requirements and goals.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $240000 \- $333000 (USD) \+ 25% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Site Reliability Engineering, Third\-Party Data Centers) on network architecture and provide valuable feedback on the physical data center environment.
* Be a globally recognized technical leader and subject matter expert on data center networking infrastructure with knowledge of data center processes, infrastructure, design, construction, and safety.
* Develop a unified global network program process and prioritization to create agility to accommodate shift\-left priority to enable an engaged advantage for Google.
* Ensure GSO is an asset across all Google\-required network infrastructure, focusing on network capacity in support of the end customer.
* Enable network capability and acceleration in support of ML (Net GT, MLNDA, Vermilion, etc.) and next gen network deployment and maintenance.

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Fluorescence Imaging at Intuitive Surgical**


The Fluorescence Imaging Team at Intuitive is developing agents designed to work seamlessly with Intuitive’s robotic platforms and Firefly imaging technology. The agents have the potential to highlight critical anatomy and disease in real time—giving surgeons clearer information at the moment decisions matter most and helping improve outcomes for patient*s.*


**Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**


The CMC Project Manager serves as a strategic and operational partner to Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) leadership, providing integrated project management for development programs from clinical development through regulatory submission, launch readiness, and commercialization. The role translates CMC strategies and technical decisions into coordinated cross\-functional project plans that enable effective execution.


Reporting to the Program Management \& Operations organization, the CMC Project Manager partners with CMC, Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Clinical Supply, Clinical Development, Commercial, Finance, Procurement, and external partners to integrate timelines, risks, dependencies, budgets, and technical decisions into unified project plans.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Support the Program Management \& Operations team in implementing CMC governance processes, including governance forums, operating cadences, decision pathways, program reporting, and the RAID framework.
* Facilitate CMC governance by preparing materials, maintaining RAID and decision logs, documenting actions and decisions, monitoring follow\-through, and escalating cross\-functional risks and decision requests, as appropriate.
* Develop, maintain, and communicate detailed CMC project plans for assigned programs, including milestones, dependencies, critical\-path activities, document workflows, key cGMP deliverables, stability pulls and reports, regulatory commitments, and cross\-functional deliverables.
* Coordinate execution across Drug Substance, Drug Product, Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Clinical Supply, and external partners, providing hands\-on project management support to assigned CMC workstreams.
* Monitor execution and proactively identify schedule impacts, resource constraints, cross\-functional dependencies, technical and operational risks, and potential budget impacts.
* Facilitate the development and implementation of mitigation plans.
* Develop and apply governance and project reporting materials that communicate milestone performance, critical\-path status, key risks, decision requests, budget impacts, and recommended actions to leadership and PM\&O teams.
* Support regular functional\-area budget management in coordination with CMC Functional Area Team Leads and PM\&O by tracking actual and forecasted accruals, invoices, purchase orders, and inputs to the Annual Operations Budget Planning Cycle.
* Support CDMO and supplier oversight by: incorporating vendor updates into project plans and governance materials; tracking purchase orders, change orders, invoices, key contract terms, and performance commitments; and coordinating business reviews and operational follow\-up across internal functions.
* Drive adoption of standardized project management tools, templates, dashboards, reporting practices, and workflow automation that improve portfolio visibility, consistency, and execution.

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree is preferred.
* Minimum 8 years of combined experience in CMC development and project management within the pharmaceutical industry, supporting small\-molecule development programs from clinical development through NDA submission and launch readiness.
* Demonstrated success in cross\-functional coordination with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical Development, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to support program planning, governance, and decision\-making.
* Expertise in timeline management, risk and issue management, resource coordination, budget tracking, vendor coordination
* Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver clear, actionable project updates and drive alignment without direct authority.
* Proficiency with Smartsheet, including detailed project planning, dashboards, reporting, and workflow automation.

* Experience supporting NDA Module 3 preparation and submission
* Experience managing CDMOs (and other suppliers)
* PMP or comparable project management certification.

jobs.description:
Title: QA Technician  
Full\-Time \| Non\-Exempt \| Hourly

POSITION OVERVIEW  
Location: Emeryville, CA (On\-site)  
Pay Rate: $24 \- $26/hour (Depending on experience)  
Department: Quality  
Reports To: QA Manager

Schedule:

Monday through Friday shifts: 4:00AM \- 12:30PM (Weekend availability a plus!)

OR

Saturday and Sunday shifts

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO \& Sick Leave

ABOUT PETIT POT  
Petit Pot is a growing food manufacturing company based in Emeryville, CA. We produce high\-quality French\-inspired desserts and are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, balancing purpose and profit while considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, community, and the environment.

POSITION SUMMARY  
The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring that all production paperwork is completed, collected, organized, reviewed, and filed to the satisfaction of all pertinent regulatory agencies and customers. Ensure the site is always audit\-ready by maintaining GMP, Organic, SQF, and any other certifications. Ensure the quality of all incoming ingredients, batches, and finished products. Perform required quality testing of products and records accurate product specifications in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of food safety protocols, quality control processes, and regulatory compliance in the food manufacturing industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all regulatory issues pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all customer requirements and preferences pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Collect all production paperwork, ensuring that any missing paperwork is located.  
\- Provide aggressive reporting and retraining for all incomplete, incorrect, or non\-compliant paperwork.  
\- Organize paperwork per established filing system.  
\- Review paperwork, ensuring that all process CCP’s, quality specifications, and customer requirements have been met. Any product affected by deviations or missing records must be reported to QA Manager and placed on QA hold.  
\- Manage filing systems such that all completed and reviewed records are maintained and accessible for the time required by customers and regulatory agencies.  
\- Release product.  
\- Provide assistance/support as needed with the customer, government, and third\-party audits.  
\- Ensure all products meet the customer and product requirements.  
\- Always keep all work areas and equipment within SQF standards and clean.  
\- Ensure all personal protective equipment is always properly worn.  
\- Ensure all equipment is set up, calibrated, and functioning properly throughout your shift.  
\- Keep all equipment that is used clean, in your area always, and prepared for the next run.  
\- Perform several checks to the batches such as Color, pH \& sensory, vacuum and % solid.  
\- Obtain batch samples by opening kettles, turning off agitators, ladle the samples, place samples in beakers, and take them to QC Bench for testing.  
\- Obtain liquid ingredient samples from bulk containers and perform testing on them.  
\- Recommend adjustments be made to batches by adding or subtracting ingredients.  
\- Monitor the Filler Machine and lines by checking the weights, charts, codes, labeling, pasteurizer temperatures and perform hourly finished product analysis.  
\- Verify codes and charts very closely \- the ink can run dry and codes can be set wrong.  
\- Perform visual checks and record results, weigh product on calibrated scales, obtain and bring the samples to the QC bench for testing, perform tests, and record results.  
\- Place batches of finished products on hold as required.  
\- Copy batch cards as required for kitchen operators.  
\- All other assigned duties required during your work period.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE  
\- GED or High School Diploma  
\- Previous QA experience in a food manufacturing environment.  
\- Ability to work with numbers, perform calculations, and possess mechanical abilities.  
\- Ability to identify food safety concerns or risks.  
\- Demonstrated ability to work independently, with limited supervision.  
\- Communication skills: must be able to communicate and work closely with all departments and management levels.  
\- Keep up with a fast\-paced work environment and record data as required in a timely manner.  
\- Extreme attention to detail.  
\- Strong organizational ability.  
\- Good communication skills (both written and verbal).  
\- General computer proficiency (Word, Excel, etc.).  
\- Ability to attend and successfully complete related training programs.  
\- Spanish (Plus, not required)

EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS USED  
\- Use the following equipment: Refractometer, Salt Titrator, Acid Titrator, PH Meter, Color Meter, Moisture Meter, Viscometer, and Consistometer, various gages, torque meters and other equipment as required.  
\- Handcarts and pallet jacks.  
\- Forklift (not all QC Techs.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
\- SQF Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- PCQI Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- HACCP Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- Experience in the food manufacturing industry required.  
\- Knowledge of food safety regulations, quality standards, and production best practices.  
\- Experience with lean manufacturing, process improvement, or waste reduction is a plus.  
\- Experience in dessert, dairy, pudding, or refrigerated food production is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  
\- Varied temperature work areas.  
\- The environment is very wet, slippery, and has continuous forklift traffic.  
\- Handle and work around various moving equipment and chemicals.  
\- Frequent use of hot/cold water to perform checks and clean equipment and area.  
\- Frequent lifting objects \< 30 lbs. and pushing/pulling of objec

jobs.description:
**About Pets in Need**

***Our mission is to provide animals with loving care and lasting homes, to partner with communities striving to do the same, and to advance our no\-kill legacy.***
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 **OVERVIEW**:This is a dynamic role that supports many programs at PIN and is primarily responsible for getting animals into homes. You are the first person that visitors meet upon emailing, calling or arriving at the shelter. Depending on the day, this could be in a group setting or a minimally supervised setting. Our CSR Team is driven to provide quality customer service, multitaskers, adaptable, goal\-oriented, creative and excited about bringing new ideas or programs to fruition to help save more lives

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


Client Services

* Greet all visitors, volunteers, staff or donors that enter the shelters.
* Treat all visitors with respect and courtesy, regardless of the reason they are seeking services. Respond to inquiries from clients in writing, over the phone, and in person in a professional manner. Provide support to clients in the community by answering inquiries with clear and accurate information about PIN programs, services, policies and municipal, county, or state animal ordinances.


\*Collect fees for PIN provided services. Solicit donations to support PIN monthly and annual fundraising goals. \*Create a comfortable and welcoming environment by keeping professional workspaces and lobbies free of clutter.


\*Attend onsite or off\-site events to advertise animals or the services PIN provides. Train staff and/or volunteers. \*As needed \- other duties will be assigned.


Adoption Counseling

* Clearly and concisely review an animal’s behavioral and medical history to accurately relay information to staff, potential adopters or volunteers.
* Facilitate adoptions by matchmaking animals with prospective adopters using a conversation\-based approach with the goal of finding the best possible outcome for the person and the animal. Become familiar with adoptable animals in the shelter and in foster homes; work hands\-on with animals and collaborate with matchmaker volunteers to conduct adoption meet\-and\-greets. Remove barriers to adoption and support inclusivity and equity in adoptions by following a progressive open adoptions model.
* Write appealing pet profiles to attract adopters, take photos or videos of animals and track animals that need photos to create a list for photography volunteers.
* Solicit post\-adoption updates and provide support to help keep animals in homes.


Animal Intake Process

* The intake of stray animals, which includes gathering information from the client, behaviorally assessing, vaccinating, microchipping and setting up housing.
* Track down information from microchipped or tagged strays to reunite pets with owners. Process return\-to\-owner paperwork and fees, and microchip animals that are being reclaimed. Track lost and found reports submitted by clients and reunite lost pets when matches are found.
* Process the intake of a variety of injured, sick, or underage wildlife, which includes handling and assessing animals and setting up housing. Process the surrender of an animal in an empathetic and compassionate manner and gather behavioral and medical history from clients.
* Process disposal and cremation requests, which include handling deceased animals. Feed and care for underage, orphaned kittens. Report medical and behavior concerns to the appropriate department.


 Community Outreach

* In collaboration with the Medical \& Outreach Team, greet clients and collect fees for Community Outreach related programs such as Community Spay \& Neuter, Community Vaccine Clinic, Community Veterinary Clinic, and Owner Requested Humane Euthanasia.
* Attend annual events such as Pet Care Assistance Day and Clear The Shelters.


Volunteer Engagement

* Act as a point\-person for volunteers at the shelter and assist with answering questions or redirecting volunteers to the appropriate person or department. As needed, help with the onboarding process for new volunteers, which includes teaching hands\-on animal handling classes, conducting orientations, and scheduling volunteers to shadow volunteer mentors.
* In collaboration with the Volunteer Team, support the Doggy Day Out program, which includes scheduling one\-time volunteers, managing supplies, handing off dogs to volunteers and retrieving information from the adventure. If comfortable, regularly engage with and post on the PIN Volunteer Facebook group.

**NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS:** Excellent customer service record. Strong interpersonal skills. The ideal person for this position would be personable, outgoing, patient, professional, and able to get along well with a variety of people. Excellent written and oral communications skills. Strong organizational and project management skills. Creativity and ability to take initiative in starting new projects. Prior experience related to animal care, veterinary care and/or animal behavior. Comfortable working with a variety of domestic species (including dogs, cats, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters, rats, reptiles, etc.) and wild species (including squirrels, small birds, birds of prey, raccoons, etc.). Ability to work with minimal supervision and direction. Strong computer skills, familiarity with Microsoft applications, ability to quickly learn to use new programs.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**Prior work experience in a rescue or municipal animal service shelter setting. Understands and utilizes positive reinforcement. Fear Free Certified. Read, write and speak Spanish.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** Ability to spend the majority of shift completing desk\-based computer tasks. Ability to complete physical tasks with long periods of standing or walking. Ability to stand, bend, twist, stoop, push and pull,

Become familiar with adoptable animals in the shelter and in foster homes; work hands\-on with animals and collaborate with matchmaker volunteers to conduct adoption meet\-and\-greets. Remove barriers to adoption and support inclusivity and equity in adoptions by following a progressive open adoptions model.
* Write appealing pet profiles to attract adopters, take photos or videos of animals and track animals that need photos to create a list for photography volunteers.

Animal Intake Process

* Process the intake of a variety of injured, sick, or underage wildlife, which includes handling and assessing animals and setting up housing. Process the surrender of an animal in an empathetic and compassionate manner and gather behavioral and medical history from clients.
* Process disposal and cremation requests, which include handling deceased animals. Feed and care for underage, orphaned kittens. Report medical and behavior concerns to the appropriate department.


 Community Outreach

* Attend annual events such as Pet Care Assistance Day and Clear The Shelters.


Volunteer Engagement

* Act as a point\-person for volunteers at the shelter and assist with answering questions or redirecting volunteers to the appropriate person or department. As needed, help with the onboarding process for new volunteers, which includes teaching hands\-on animal handling classes, conducting orientations, and scheduling volunteers to shadow volunteer mentors.
* In collaboration with the Volunteer Team, support the Doggy Day Out program, which includes scheduling one\-time volunteers, managing supplies, handing off dogs to volunteers and retrieving information from the adventure. If comfortable, regularly engage with and post on the PIN Volunteer Facebook group.

**NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS:** Excellent customer service record. Strong interpersonal skills. The ideal person for this position would be personable, outgoing, patient, professional, and able to get along well with a variety of people. Excellent written and oral communications skills. Strong organizational and project management skills. Creativity and ability to take initiative in starting new projects. Prior experience related to animal care, veterinary care and/or animal behavior. Comfortable working with a variety of domestic species (including dogs, cats, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters, rats, reptiles, etc.) and wild species (including squirrels, small birds, birds of prey, raccoons, etc.). Ability to work with minimal supervision and direction. Strong computer skills, familiarity with Microsoft applications, ability to quickly learn to use new programs.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**Prior work experience in a rescue or municipal animal service shelter setting. Understands and utilizes positive reinforcement. Fear Free Certified. Read, write and speak Spanish.

Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. **About the Role:**


Crusoe's **Recruiting and People Operations** teams move fast \- and pre\-employment programs sit at the critical handoff point between an accepted offer and a confirmed start date. As the People Operations Manager, Pre\-Employment Programs, you will own the orchestration of our pre\-employment checks \- including background checks, drug and alcohol tests, immigration checks, etc \- ensuring each candidate moves smoothly and compliantly from offer to Day 1\.


You will manage the vendor relationship with our pre\-employment check vendor and act as the connective tissue between Recruiting and Onboarding Programs, translating today's ad hoc handoffs into a documented, auditable process with clear roles and responsibilities. This role also owns the administration of Crusoe's background screening and drug and alcohol testing programs, including DOT and non\-DOT populations, ensuring programs are compliant, well\-governed, and consistently executed as the company scales. This is a full\-time, onsite position based in San Francisco, CA, for someone who wants to build the operational backbone behind a high\-stakes, high\-visibility process.

 **What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Vendor Relationship Management:** Own the end\-to\-end relationship with Crusoe's background check and drug/alcohol testing vendor(s) \- service performance, escalations, contract renewals, and issue resolution.

* **Drug \& Alcohol Testing Program Administration:** Oversee the administration of our pre\-employment and support the administration of the random, post\-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return\-to\-duty testing programs, including maintaining appropriate testing pools for DOT and non\-DOT populations.
* **Process Design \& Documentation:** Design and document the end\-to\-end pre\-employment process, including a clear RACI that defines roles and responsibilities across Recruiting, People Operations, and Onboarding.
* **Compliance \& Adjudication Partnership:** Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Employee Relations on adjudication decisions, job profile designation (safety\-sensitive, DOT, PHMSA), and FCRA\-compliant recordkeeping.
* **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Serve as the connective tissue between Recruiting and Onboarding, ensuring handoffs are seamless and no candidate falls through the cracks.
* **Training \& Enablement:** Build training, documentation, and communications for Recruiting, People Operations, Onboarding, and hiring managers on pre\-employment requirements and processes.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor turnaround times, error rates, and candidate experience data; identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and consistency as volume grows.

 **What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Pre\-Employment Program Expertise:** Experience administering background check and/or drug and alcohol testing programs, ideally within a high\-growth or regulated environment.
* **Vendor Management:** Proven ability to manage external vendor relationships, holding partners accountable to SLAs and resolving service issues.
* **Process Design:** A track record of designing and documenting end\-to\-end processes, including defining roles and responsibilities across cross\-functional teams.
* **Regulatory Fluency:** Working knowledge of FCRA and DOT/PHMSA screening and testing requirements, and how they apply to job profile designation.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Experience partnering with Recruiting, Onboarding, Compliance, Legal, and Employee Relations to deliver a consistent candidate and employee experience.
* **Systems Proficiency:** Comfort working within an ATS and HRIS (e.g. Ashby, Rippling) to track and manage screening statuses.
* **Operational Rigor:** Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple candidates and cases simultaneously without missing a deadline.
* **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience, with 5\+ years of experience in People Operations, Recruiting Operations, or a related compliance function.

 **Bonus Points**

* Prior experience supporting a DOT\-regulated workforce or other safety\-sensitive population.
* Experience building or significantly overhauling a pre\-employment or background screening program from the ground up.

jobs.title: Sr. Account Manager, AWS ISV
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The AWS ISV sales team is responsible for serving the needs of medium to large ISV customers. Our team takes pride in leading customers through an accelerated and innovative cloud and AI journey and in creating long\-term business relationships of value and trust.  

  

The Sr. Account Manager is responsible for creating and executing the account strategy, and leading the extended team so both the customer and AWS grow. In addition to being customers, the ISVs partner with AWS on Go\-To\-Market programs, and our respective sales teams work together in the field. The Sr. Account Manager will work closely with the AWS Partner Team to ensure they are developing programs that are aligned with the ISV customers' strategy. It is critical that the Sr. Account Manager has an extensive track record of building and nurturing senior level relationships with complex customers, has a hands\-on approach to developing new opportunities, has public cloud technical acumen, and has led a large team of extended resources.  

  

As part of the AWS ISV sales team, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a motivated team that values and encourages diversified perspectives and ideas to best equip customers with the most innovative and comprehensive solutions. The individual will have extensive big account experience building and nurturing CXO relationships as they will manage the relationship with some of the most important and influential AWS customers and deliver ground\-breaking solutions to help their customers achieve the game\-changing benefits of the cloud at scale. Must have experience managing high revenue, strategically important customers.  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The Sr. Account Manager is responsible for teaming up with all aspects of the customer’s organization. This includes C\-level executives, engineering, product, AI, IT/operations, partner org, and sales. Skills required to build relationships across an account include creative systems thinking, visioning, and executing via collaboration with an extended team to address all ISV customer's needs.  

  

The Sr. Account Manager is responsible for selling at the most strategic (C\-level) within the account and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer acceptance and service implementation. The Sr. Account Manager works collaboratively with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Partner, Support, Solution Architect) to support customer interests, and will understand how to strongly advocate for the customer in harmony with what the AWS business needs. In addition to new service adoption and new line of business development, this role includes dotted line responsibility for partnership and technical collaboration  

  

A day in the life  

* Exceed annual revenue and win targets
* Drive levers for growth of the business: inclusive of Account Plans, GTM programs to drive adoption of our ISV partners’ products, working closely with marketing and partner teams
* Engage and direct functional teams such as demand generation and curate a healthy sales pipeline
* Collaborate with partners to oversee enablement trainings and account prospecting workshops
* In partnership with Sales Ops, manage all operational aspects of the business; e.g. SFDC
* Develop long\-term strategic relationships with AWS Executives and Partner management teams
* Embrace and drive the Amazon culture
* Increase and foster high customer satisfaction.

  

About the team  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all  

sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by  

providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep  

to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that  

accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most  

adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of technology sales experience
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS technologies
* Experience engaging and influencing C\

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

The Customer Success Operations Manager \- CS Experience is a strategic operations leader responsible for driving complex, cross\-functional initiatives that improve how Customer Success roles operate at Docusign. This role translates strategy into processes, tools, and operating rhythms that enable Customer Success teams to execute consistently, reduce friction, and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes and will focus on our most strategic initiatives.  

  

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success Experience.  

  

**Responsibility**
* Act as Customer Success Operations lead for Customer Success Experience, owning P0/P1 transformation initiatives and major change programs from design through execution ensuring plans, dependencies, and risks are visible and proactively managed
* Translate Customer Success Experience strategy into clear program charters, roadmaps, success metrics, and operating rhythms across Customer Success, Sales, Services, and cross\-functional partners
* Design and refine Business Process workflows and Customer Success processes and SOPs that connect roles, playbooks, and systems (Salesforce, Gainsight, Certinia, analytics tools) into a coherent operating model
* Work with data and analytics partners to define telemetry needs, success metrics, and reporting that help Customer Success leaders run the business (e.g., GRACV/GNACV, adoption, churn, pipeline of IAM opportunities)
* Partner with technology teams and Customer Success Experience Architects to prioritize, scope, and deliver systems enhancements, ensuring requirements are business\-led and well documented
* Build and maintain program governance, including forums, cadences, and artifacts that keep leaders aligned on priorities, trade\-offs, and progress
* Prepare high\-quality executive\-level communications and materials (decks, narratives, decision briefs) that clearly surface issues, options, and recommendations
* Serve as a trusted partner to Customer Success and Go To Market leadership, proactively identifying operational risks, gaps, and opportunities and driving resolution
* Champion Docusign's principles (Customer First, Deliver Results, Say What Matters, Own It, Make It Better, One Team) in how programs are designed, communicated, and executed

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

  

  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**
* 8\+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy and Operations, or related roles
* Experience leading complex cross\-functional programs from concept through implementation, with clear business impact
* Experience with Customer Success and Go To Market processes (renewals, forecasting, adoption programs, playbooks, success planning) and how they show up in tools
* Experience working with data and analytics, including defining metrics, partnering with analytics teams, and interpreting dashboards to drive decisions
* Experience with Salesforce and Gainsight (or similar CRM/CS platforms) and how telemetry and data pipelines support CS operations
* Experience building structured plans, managing dependencies, and coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups
* Experience with executive and stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority

**Preferred**
* Experience in B2B SaaS
* Strong strategic thinking skills, able to connect company and CS strategy to concrete operational plans and system requirements
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to create concise, executive\-ready narratives and presentations
* Experience managing global business management systems for Customer Success
* Extensive experience driving annual planning, leading projects from start to finish to deliver large\-scale, complex business and technical initiatives successfully and on time in high\-growth, performance\-focused environments
* Ability to model business processes using various tools and techniques
* Proactive approach to collaboration across multiple functions and geographies to achieve complex objectives
* Demonstrated ability to lead large cross\-functional teams, mentor, coach, and effectively transfer expertise to others
* Strong influencing skills and ability to build lasting relationships at multiple organizational levels
* Knowledge of Salesforce, Tableau, Gong, and Gainsight software
* High ownership mindset, bias toward action, and comfort operating in dynamic, ambiguous environments
* Identifies opportunities to increase value or red

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **Change the way the world travels**



Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it's all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary \- including yours.



Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.


### **Team mission**


We're looking for an Account Manager to join our Sales team in San Francisco You'll own a book of business made up of mid\-market supplier partners across the US and Canada, with full accountability for their performance, satisfaction, and commercial growth on our platform.



You'll build trust \& influence with your accounts, act as their strategic partner, and find every opportunity to help them thrive. That means pitching new expansion ideas, solving problems, digging into data, and showing up for your partners in a way that makes GetYourGuide their most valuable business relationship.



This is a role for someone who's commercially sharp, genuinely curious, and excited about being part of a company that's redefining how people explore the world.


**Please note we operate hybrid working:** Monday, Tuesdays and Thursdays in office, and Wednesday and Friday remote days.


### **Your mission**


* Manage and grow a book of business consisting of mid\-market supplier accounts (tours, activities, and experience providers), understand your assigned market(s), and hit your performance targets
* Empower your accounts for success through education, resources, and enablement and become their go\-to partner at GetYourGuide for growth and strategy to drive long\-term retention
* Pitch, cross\-sell, and upsell to win high\-velocity commercial opportunities including new activity listings, increased availability, and commission negotiations
* Partner with internal teams to identify roadblocks, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and escalate tactfully to provide a world\-class supplier experience
* Focus on operational excellence and monitor partner health by solving supplier challenges such as reducing cancellation rates, promoting on\-trip quality, and increasing review scoring to foster a great customer/traveler experience
* Review account performance regularly, share clear insights with management, and proactively flag opportunities for expansion

### **Your toolkit**


* 2 to 3 years of experience in Account Management or Customer Success, ideally in tech or a marketplace environment
* A track record of hitting (and beating) commercial targets
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with partners quickly
* A data\-driven mindset; you're comfortable working with performance metrics and turning numbers into action
* Passion for shaping the future of sales and partner success in the age of AI. You thrive in fast\-paced environments, using available resources to build and scale efficiently
* Great problem\-solving skills and a proactive, ownership\-oriented attitude
* Enthusiasm for travel and genuine enthusiasm for what GetYourGuide stands for

### **How we'll make your career journey extraordinary**

  


* 10 Paid Sick Days Per Year
* 40 Telecomuting Days
* 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave for the birth of your child
* Marriage Leave \- 3 days
* 401k Plan \- a retirement plan (after 6 month employment), GYG offer company contribution match of up to 3\.5%, 100% vested
* Healthcare \- medical, dental and vision options
	+ Medical by Anthem: BlueCross BlueShield with 3 plans\-Platinum PPO, Gold PPO, and Silver PPO \+ HSA.
	+ Option for FSA (Flexible Spending Accounts), HSA (Health Savings Accounts)
	+ Sunlife Dental \& Vision
	+ Others: Basic Life Insurance (no charge), Short Term Disability Insurance (no charge), Voluntary Life Insurance, Voluntary Long Term Disability Insurance, Voluntary Accident Insurance, Voluntary Specified Disease Insurance, TotalPet, InfoArmor
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Family and Friends Discount
* Contribution toward foreign Language classes
* Learning Budget \- 1,000 Euro per year
* Maven Family Planning
* Transportation reimbursement benefi
* Lunch Provided in office twice a week

  



And more…


### **Starting salary**


* $97,000 base ($121,000 OTE)

### **How to apply**



Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out 'how we hire' and 'life at GetYourGuide'. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.


### **We're an equal opportunities employer**



Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID\-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.  

  



Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life\-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

As a Gilead intern will support the planning, execution, and oversight of global clinical trials across multiple therapeutic areas. You will partner with Clinical Operations professionals and cross\-functional stakeholders to gain practical experience in the execution of Phase I to Phase IV clinical studies while contributing to meaningful projects that support patient\-focused drug development. jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
The Livermore Lab Foundation (LLF) is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization established in 2016 to advance scientific research and inspire the next generation of scientists and engineers to help ‘open the door’ to a better future for all. As a key partner to Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), a Department of Energy national security laboratory in Livermore, California, the Foundation raises philanthropic funds to support Lab research, student fellowships, and community engagement initiatives.

**Position Summary**

Reporting to the Executive Director, the Operations Associate will support the Foundation’s day\-to\-day office and administrative functions as they related to the organization’s financials, grants/contracts, human resources, information technology, development, and more. As a new role in the organization, the position requires a highly organized professional who can work independently while coordinating with team members in multiple locations. Because this position balances a variety of responsibilities, a high degree of flexibility, a professional attitude, and significant initiative and attention to detail are required. Our ideal candidate is familiar with business management best practices, is interested in working in the nonprofit sector and is committed to LLF’s mission. Note: this is a 40 hour per week, hybrid position with expectations of at least 3\-4 days per week in the Livermore office.

**Primary Responsibilities**

Key duties include but are not limited to:

*Administration* 

* Refine and maintain formal employment and administrative systems, policies, and internal procedures for all functions of the Foundation’s day\-to\-day operations. Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local laws and appropriate nonprofit standards.
* Support management of the Foundation’s customer relationship management (CRM) system (Neon donor database) to ensure that constituents, communications and gifts are properly documented and updated. This includes maintaining donor accounts and tracking gift records, supporting team in ensuring appropriate stewardship and communication, and coordination and execution of timely email and print correspondence.
* Manage general organizational renewals, document retention and organization. This includes insurance, membership and subscription renewals, invoices, and other legal and financial compliance requirements.
* Assist in preparation and processing of invoices, grant reports, and other organizational communications as needed.
* Support LLF Board meetings and committees (take minutes, track action items, write and send follow up reports).
* Provide general administrative support to the team and perform other duties as assigned by the Executive Director.

*Finance/Bookkeeping* 

* Support the creation of and monitor the organization’s annual operating and program budgets, including financial grant reporting.
* Support contract and grant management to ensure compliance with documentation and reporting.
* Prepare financial documents and summaries, including regular board communications and grant reports in coordination with the Foundation’s financial team, to accurately reflect the financial condition of the organization.
* Support all bookkeeping functions including A/R, A/P and payroll.
* Assist off\-site accountant in preparing for LLF’s audit and federal and state taxes and reports.

*General Office Operations* 

* Help design and implement an ongoing process for tracking grants and contracts, including research, proposal submissions, reporting, and billing/payment cycles in coordination with LLNL.
* Liaison with the Foundation’s IT consultant to ensure appropriate technology systems and controls are maintained throughout Foundation operations.
* Assist in planning and executing Foundation events and activities, including annual student showcase and donor cultivation and stewardship programs.
* Provide as\-needed on\-site facility management and operational support to the University of California Livermore Collaboration Center (UCLCC), where the LLF office is located, including on\-site assistance for building users and guests, meeting and special event support, coordination of building access, assistance with emergency procedures, backup administration of event calendaring and room reservations, and basic troubleshooting of UCLCC audiovisual systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least two years nonprofit or business management experience
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities, including demonstrated experience with office management, human resources and financial reporting
* Solid financial acumen with ability to prepare budget documents and support accounting and reporting processes
* Proficient in QuickBooks Online (minimum of two years preferred), Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, Dropbox, and Neon (or similar donor database software)
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills and ability to collaborate and correspond with staff, Board, consultants, donors and volunteers
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Available to work occasional evenings and possible weekends

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of nonprofit governance, compliance or financial best practices
* Experience with CRM database management
* Experience with contract and grant management
* Previous experience or demonstrated interest in science research or STEAM (Science, Technology, Education, Art and Math) fields

**Licensure and Other Requirements**

* Valid California driver’s license and automobile insurance (may require some travel within the Tri\-Valley region)
* Must reside in California and live a commutable distance from LLF office at the time of hire
* Background check will be required post\-offer in compliance with California state laws

**Compensation and Benefits**
