jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, corporate/internal communications, management consulting, Google Ads sales or sales enablement, or a related field.
* 3 years of project management experience working across cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating high\-level strategies into polished assets alongside creative partners, video producers, and agencies.
* Experience in, experimenting with and leveraging emerging AI tools to optimize daily workflows or enhance creative output.
* Sharp critical thinking and creative investigative skills to structure and resolve complex operational issues.
* Strong background in Google Ads products, sales tech, or market trends, with an active drive to simplify sellers' day\-to\-day workflows.
* Proven track record as a versatile all\-rounder managing multiple workflows and shifting priorities in changing environments.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Creative in Marketing, you bring visual, design, written and experiential acumen to Google products and services, presented across all major media, content, channels, and experiences. You have the ability to perform your role in a flexible, ever\-changing environment and must be open to new influences and inspiration. You will work with a deeply cross\-functional team and inspire a team of vendor partners by sharing ideas and developing effective solutions to generate multiple concepts supporting all forms of major media. You will be equally comfortable making; rolling up your sleeves and designing, mocking, writing, or prototyping; showing, not telling. Above all, you will inspire and lead by example by making the most of every opportunity to develop breakthrough creative, consistent with the Google Marketing brand, and be able to take and provide clear direction and creative feedback that pushes work forward.

As a Marketing and Communications Manager on the Google Compute Engine (GCE) Marketing team, you will be an all\-rounder combining structured thinking, compelling storytelling, and rapid execution. You will pivot seamlessly from drafting concise executive updates to creative seller\-facing narratives, high\-level strategy, or asset production (videos, templates). You will translate complex AI and product concepts into clear stories, thriving in ambiguity to address whatever issues come next.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $116000 \- $166000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Craft beautifully written, punchy, and highly polished communications, executive updates, newsletters, and slide copy that make complex Ads products, sales training initiatives, and AI tools instantly understandable.

**Alpaca is a US\-headquartered, global leader in agent\-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

jobs.title: International Assessments Program - Associate Program Leader for Counterterrorism - Z Program
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have an opening for an **Associate Program Leader** for the Counterterrorism (CT) group within the International Assessments (IA) Program to lead a dynamic team developing and executing the work of the Laboratory in support of intelligence missions in foreign nuclear weapons programs and threats involving radiological or nuclear (R/N) terrorism, and R/N materials. You will serve as a key member of the IA Program leadership team responsible for addressing workforce needs, safety, security, technical quality, standards, and project management to enhance the Laboratory's contributions to national security. In addition, you will substantively oversee the CT group’s analytic portfolio. This position is in the IA Program within Global Security Principal Directorate’s Z Program.  

  

**In this role, you will**

* Serve as a member of the IA Program leadership team, influencing the development and implementation of institutional objectives and goals.
* Provide technical and analytical leadership to technical staff to develop and provide subject matter expertise and analysis of foreign nuclear weapons programs and threats involving radiological or nuclear (R/N) terrorism, and R/N materials for multiple government sponsors.
* Identify and pursue program development opportunities, develop an internal investment strategy and work with IA Program Leader, as well as leaders in Z and other Laboratory Programs and Directorates to identify and pursue collaborative projects.
* Formulate and execute short\-term and strategic goals for the program, including setting the program’s annual research agenda and producing highly advanced, finished intelligence analysis, reports, and briefings that meet intelligence community (IC) tradecraft standards.
* Provide project management oversight for the program’s analytic portfolio, including developing project execution plans and ensuring appropriate resource allocation, timelines, and review of the group’s deliverables.
* Assist in planning and direct activities for staffing of CT projects; manage program budget, allocate resources, determine qualification standards and attract, retain, recruit, and select staff with technical expertise.
* Lead performance management and career development activities for all members of the CT group, including conducting quarterly check\-in and regular 1:1 meetings, writing performance reviews, and providing input for matrix personnel. Develop, implement, and maintain a mentoring program for analysts and principal investigators to support the career development goals of all team members.
* Build, maintain, and enhance strong relationships with external and internal sponsors, customers, and stakeholders to ensure exquisite execution of projects and satisfaction of commitments.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Additional job responsibilities, at the SEL.5 Level**

* Develop innovative concepts and provide expert leadership, technical vision, and strategic planning for both analytic and scientific research and development.
* Present project accomplishments and meet customer expectations, as well as identify new opportunities, goals, and application areas by leading the development of proposals interacting with senior program management.
* Develop and implement new innovative analytical capabilities within the program and apply them against an expanding portfolio.
* Influence strategic decisions made by senior management and external customers at the national level.


### **Qualifications**


* This position requires an active DOE Q clearance at the time of hire and the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access.
* Master’s degree in physical science, nuclear physics, weapons design, engineering, political science or related discipline, or the equivalent combination of education and extensive related experience.

jobs.description:
**Lead Care Manager (Community Health Advocate)**

*(Field\-Based — Assigned to Your Local Home County)*

**Company:** OverSightMD Inc.

**Hiring Locations:** Santa Clara County, Monterey County, Santa Cruz County, San Benito County, and Merced County

**Compensation:** Starting at $28\.00/hour

**Job Type:** Part\-Time *(High need for afternoon shifts: 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM)*; Full\-Time also available

**Benefits:** Health Insurance, 401(k) *(for full\-time employees)*

Note to Applicants: OverSightMD is hiring Care Managers across multiple Central California counties. You will be assigned to work primarily within the county where you currently live to build deep, authentic connections with your neighbors.**Turn Your Life Experience Into a Career That Matters**

Are you the person in your family who always takes grandma to her doctor’s appointments? Did you have to fight to get a friend or family member the care they needed? Have you navigated the challenges of housing instability, recovery, or re\-entering the community yourself?

OverSightMD is looking for **Lead Care Managers** to join our Enhanced Care Management (ECM) team. We are looking for people with "Lived Experience"—people who have walked a mile in the shoes of the members we serve.

If you are a natural advocate, a problem solver, and someone who genuinely loves to help others, we want to train you to be a professional Care Manager.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for "Community Champions." You might be a perfect fit if:

* **You are a Caregiver:** You have experience caring for aging parents, grandparents, or family members with disabilities. You know how hard it is to manage medications and appointments.
* **You are an Advocate:** You have navigated the healthcare system for yourself, a child, or a loved one. You know how to ask doctors the right questions.
* **You Have "Lived Experience":** You or a loved one have experienced homelessness, substance use recovery, the justice system, or mental health challenges. You understand the stigma and the barriers.
* **You Volunteer:** You spend time at food pantries, homeless shelters, church groups, or community events because you care about your neighbors.

**Required Skills**

* **Bilingual (Strongly Preferred):** Fluency in Spanish is highly desired to help us communicate directly with the communities we serve.
* **Tech\-Savvy:** You must have basic computer skills. You will be documenting your visits and member stories on a laptop/tablet.
* **Mobile \& Reliable:** You must have a reliable vehicle, a valid driver’s license, and auto insurance. This is a field\-based role—you will be visiting members in their homes, at shelters, or in the community *(mileage is paid!)*.

**What You Will Do**

As a Lead Care Manager, you are the bridge between the healthcare system and the real world. Your primary job is to build trust.

* **Build Relationships:** Visit members where they are—whether that’s a home, a shelter, or a coffee shop. Listen to their stories without judgment.
* **Advocate:** Go to doctor’s appointments with members to ensure they are heard and understood.
* **Connect to Resources:** Help members find housing support, food banks, transportation, or legal aid.
* **Transition Support:** Help members move safely from the hospital or a nursing facility back into their own homes.
* **Empower:** Teach members how to manage their own health, reminding them that they are capable and worthy of care.

**The People We Serve**

You will be working with local residents across **Santa Clara, Monterey, Santa Cruz, San Benito, and Merced counties** who simply need a helping hand to manage their health. Most of our members are everyday people struggling with chronic conditions who need support staying on top of doctor’s appointments, medications, and follow\-ups.

* **Families, Youth \& Seniors:** Helping aging parents stay independent at home or ensuring foster youth get the care they need.
* **Pregnant \& Postpartum Moms:** Supporting healthy pregnancies and helping new moms navigate the healthcare system.
* **Neighbors with Chronic Health Needs:** Helping people manage things like diabetes or heart disease so they can stay healthy and out of the hospital.
* **Community Members Seeking Stability:** Assisting those facing housing insecurity or other life challenges to connect with the resources they need to thrive.

**Why Work With OverSightMD?**

* **Meaningful Work:** This isn't just a job; it’s an opportunity to change the trajectory of someone’s life using the wisdom you’ve gained from your own experiences.
* **Training Provided:** We will teach you the technical parts of the job. We just need you to bring the empathy and the drive.
* **Competitive Pay:** Starting at $28\.00 an hour.
* **Flexible Schedules:** Morning and afternoon shifts available *(Afternoon shifts from 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM are highly preferred right now).*
* **Real Benefits:** We offer a 401(k) and Health Benefits for full\-time employees to ensure you and your family are taken care of.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief note telling us why you are passionate about this work. Tell us about your "lived experience"—we want to hear your story!

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: From $28\.00 per hour

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Please send with your resume a brief description, telling us why you are passionate about this work. Tell us about your "lived experience"—we want to hear your story.
* Sometimes people may be hesitant to accept help. How would you encourage someone to feel comfortable receiving support?
* How do you learn about local resources to help others?

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Position:** Full\-Time (W\-2\)  
**Location:** Remote, with travel as needed, up to 30%  
**Reports To:** Chief Customer Officer  
**Start Date:** Immediately

**The role**

You will be the primary leader for your assigned accounts and the voice of the client inside Enliven. You will coordinate analytics, negotiation, operations, and other specialists around client outcomes. Success means owning the relationship, the process, and the result, not personally performing every specialist task.

Generally speaking, over the course of a year, approximately 50% of this role will focus on account management, 25% on sales\-related activities, and 25% on RFP and sourcing leadership. The actual mix will change with the ebbs and flows of the business, and the number of RFPs will vary based on client timing, scope, and complexity. At times, account leadership will demand most of your attention. At other times, prospecting, industry representation, RFP activity, or business development will take priority. The right person will be energized by that variety and comfortable contributing wherever they can create the most value for clients and Enliven.

**About Enliven**

Enliven helps large organizations that purchase significant volumes of non\-alcoholic beverages generate significant cost savings and increased revenue through exclusive and semi\-exclusive beverage agreements and pouring rights. We help leaders negotiate their first or next beverage partnership, typically with Coca\-Cola, PepsiCo, or Keurig Dr Pepper, and optimize the resulting program to grow sales, reduce labor costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

We negotiate and manage best\-in\-class beverage partnerships for leading organizations across the restaurant, healthcare, entertainment, retail, and aviation industries.

**The opportunity**

Enliven is seeking a commercially minded Account Manager to inherit and lead a portfolio of approximately 5\-10 client relationships, grow those accounts, quarterback complex beverage sourcing and RFP work, and help generate new business.

This is an entrepreneurial role for someone who enjoys both serving clients and creating opportunities, and who can shift between those priorities as the needs of a growing small business change.

**What you’ll own**Client relationships, retention, and growth

* Take immediate ownership of a portfolio of approximately 5\-10 accounts, leading each relationship from onboarding and ongoing delivery through renewal and growth.
* Build trusted relationships across each client organization, including executive sponsors, day\-to\-day contacts, and other influential stakeholders.
* Maintain a clear account plan for every relationship, including health, commitments, priorities, value delivered, open issues, risks, renewal strategy, growth opportunities, and next steps.
* Make Enliven’s value visible through proactive communication, executive\-ready summaries, business reviews, recommendations, and consistent follow\-through.
* Identify retention, expansion, scope, and relationship risks early, recommend action, and escalate when the situation requires it.

RFPs, sourcing, and strategic partnerships

* Quarterback beverage RFPs and competitive sourcing engagements from strategy and timeline through evaluation, recommendation, award, and implementation.
* Translate client goals into clear internal priorities, deliverables, decisions, and deadlines.
* Coordinate analytics, negotiation, operations, and other specialists while respecting clear ownership, capacity constraints, and team work queues.
* Build productive beverage\-company relationships and lead communication about performance, commitments, opportunities, renewals, negotiations, and competitive processes.
* Drive measurable growth within existing accounts by improving contract compliance and increasing beverage volume through marketing and promotional activities aligned with available beverage\-company resources.
* Own follow\-through across complex engagements, surfacing resource needs, competing priorities, scope questions, and delivery risks early.

New business and market presence

* Develop qualified opportunities through relationships, referrals, industry connections, thoughtful outbound activity, conferences, and Enliven’s broader business\-development efforts.
* Represent Enliven credibly in the industries we serve, build early\-stage relationships, and help prospective clients understand the value of Enliven’s work.
* Advance prospects with persistence and sound judgment, maintain accurate pipeline activity and forecasts, and ask for the business.
* Contribute directly to both new\-logo revenue and growth within existing accounts.

Operating discipline and teamwork

* Maintain accurate CRM activity, account plans, forecasts, commitments, and next steps so priorities and decisions remain visible.
* Use good judgment about when to act independently, seek specialist input, involve other Enliven resources, or escalate to the Chief Customer Officer.
* Partner directly across Enliven’s two operating pillars without creating competing priorities or work queues.
* Adapt quickly as account service, sales, travel, and internal priorities ebb and flow.
* Step into the work that creates the most value for clients and Enliven while maintaining ownership of core account commitments.

**What success looks like**

* A healthy, well\-led portfolio with strong relationships, visible client value, proactive risk management, and clear renewal and growth plans.
* High retention and expansion, well\-run sourcing and RFP processes, and smooth awards and implementations.
* A consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities and meaningful new and expanded business closed.
* Clients experience one accountable relationship leader, even when the work involves multiple Enliven specialists.
* Increasing autonomy, strong commercial judgment, reliable cross\-functional leadership, and consistent follow\-through.

jobs.description:
Thrive is a leading behavior change technology company founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016 with the mission to end the stress and burnout epidemic. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well\-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI\-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science\-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 125 organizations in over 140 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies.

  

Thrive for Support Teams (TST) is a dedicated area of our business focused on frontline support organizations, primarily contact centers and the teams that support them inside large enterprises. * **You are comfortable with data.** You can interpret engagement and outcomes data, identify meaningful trends, and turn insights into clear recommendations and compelling client stories.
* **You are commercially minded.** You understand how strong program delivery translates into retention and growth, and you are comfortable building the value case and leading renewal, pricing, and contract conversations.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Trilliant Food \& Nutrition is a leading manufacturer of premium coffees and powdered beverages, proudly headquartered in Little Chute, Wisconsin. With a legacy rooted in quality, innovation, and service, Trilliant delivers branded and private label solutions across retail, foodservice, and e\-commerce channels.

  




Horseshoe Beverage Company, based in Neenah, WI, is a leading ready\-to\-drink beverage manufacturer dedicated to delivering an exceptional beverage experience. By combining industry\-leading talent and cutting\-edge equipment, we drive innovation and consistently deliver the highest quality products to our customers—first and fast.

  



Our brand portfolio includes Victor Allen’s®, Dutch Bros® beverages and Nurri™, our better\-for\-you protein beverage line. We are passionate about beverages – and about building a team that’s just as energized. We invite you to explore opportunities at Trilliant or Horseshoe, to see if your talents and career aspirations may fit with our openings.

  


**Our Core Values:**

  


**Position Overview:**



The Customer Operations Program Manager serves as the strategic operational partner for assigned customers and is accountable for a standardized way of work across customer operational performance, inventory and replenishment insights, service execution, compliance, cost\-to\-serve visibility, and continuous improvement. The role is aligned to the customer not to a brand portfolio and develops deep knowledge of the customer’s systems, requirements, inventory position, replenishment processes, service expectations, and operational priorities.



The COPM connects customer data and operational signals to action. The role works closely with Sales and cross\-functional partners to identify risks and opportunities, provide actionable insights, facilitate root\-cause resolution, and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through.



For this specific customer assignment, the COPM will support Walmart and Sam’s Club and must bring demonstrated replenishment and customer operational experience supporting both Walmart and Sam’s Club. This role requires deep working knowledge of Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment processes, systems, inventory and POS data, and customer\-specific operational requirements, including hands\-on experience with Retail Link and Nova.

  


**Responsibilities:**


**Customer Operational Partnership**


* Develop an intimate understanding of assigned customers, including customer systems, processes, replenishment requirements, service expectations, operational contacts, and business priorities.


* Serve as the primary operational partner for assigned customers in partnership with the Sales account owner.


* Establish a consistent customer operating cadence, including operational/replenishment reviews, KPI reviews, risk and opportunity discussions, action tracking, and escalation.


* Translate customer needs and operational signals into clear actions and connect work to the appropriate internal partner through resolution.


**Inventory, Replenishment \& POS Analytics**


* Monitor and analyze customer POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock levels, weeks of supply, order patterns, MABD/fill\-rate compliance, OTIF/service performance, and other customer\-specific inventory and replenishment measures.


* Identify out\-of\-stock risk, excess or imbalanced inventory, replenishment gaps, order opportunities, service risk, and other material customer\-operational concerns.


* Perform root\-cause analysis and provide actionable recommendations to improve in\-stock, inventory flow, replenishment, service, and the cost of moving product optimally.


* Provide order/replenishment recommendations using customer demand signals, inventory position, transit and lead\-time considerations, promotions, seasonality, and customer requirements.


* Prepare customer\-specific replenishment/performance reporting and lead or participate in recurring customer replenishment meetings.


* Develop and improve replenishment tools, reporting, processes, and standard work as business and customer requirements evolve.


* Serve as the customer operations and replenishment subject\-matter expert for Walmart and Sam’s Club, maintaining deep knowledge of customer\-specific replenishment processes, systems, metrics, reporting, and operational expectations.


* Utilize Walmart and Sam’s Club systems, including Retail Link and Nova, to analyze POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock performance, replenishment trends, order activity, and other customer\-specific operational data.


* Prepare for and lead recurring replenishment and operational performance discussions with Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment teams, identifying risks, opportunities, root causes, and recommended actions.


**Demand \& Forecast Insights**


* Gather and translate customer POS and/or DC, inventory, replenishment, order, promotional, seasonal, and other customer demand signals into actionable insights for Sales, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.


* Provide forecast recommendations and proactively identify material changes in demand or inventory position.


* Maintain an active seat at the business table by ensuring customer and replenishment insights inform commercial and operational planning.


**Customer Operational Performance**


* Own visibility to customer operational KPIs, including OTIF, in\-stock, MABD/fill rate, inventory position/weeks of supply, replenishment performance, service performance, compliance, and applicable cost\-to\-serve measures.


* Maintain visibility to purchase\-order\-through\-delivery performance and partner with Customer Service, Logistics, Supply Chain, and other functions to identify systemic execution issues.


* Monitor applicable customer compliance requirements, deductions, chargebacks/fines, and recurring operational failures; coordinate root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and prevention with cross\-functional partners.

**ONE LAST THING TO ASK YOURSELF**



All this might sound great, but you're probably still wondering, "Would I be a good fit for Known?" or "Would Known be a good fit for me?" jobs.title: Technical Field Operations Manager - Special Hazards
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Vice President, IFP, this role combines technical leadership, people management, resource planning, and field operations oversight with involvement in project estimating and planning. You’ll lead a team of Field Technicians, serve as a senior technical resource for complex field challenges, and work closely with Project Management, Sales, and Engineering to ensure projects are accurately scoped, appropriately staffed, and successfully executed from installation through commissioning and closeout.


*This position is classified as remote and can be located anywhere in the United States, with a preference for candidates located in Kansas, Indiana, Texas, or Arizona.*


**We think you’ll thrive if:**


* You’re an experienced fire protection professional who can confidently lead both people and technical execution.
* You enjoy developing technicians, setting clear expectations, and building a team that operates with accountability and consistency.
* You’re comfortable solving complex field problems and making sound decisions when conditions don’t go according to plan.
* You can balance people, schedules, customer needs, project demands, and business priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* You understand that strong field execution starts before anyone arrives on site and can bring a practical field perspective to estimating, planning, and project handoffs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage Field Operations personnel, including workload prioritization, technical direction, performance expectations, coaching, development, and accountability.
* Plan and allocate field resources across active projects in coordination with Project Management and Sales.
* Oversee installation, commissioning, acceptance testing, and service activities to support safe, compliant, high\-quality, and timely project execution.

* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis involving system failures, false discharges, deficiencies, and other complex technical conditions.

* Build the technical capability of the Field Operations team through training, coaching, standardization, cross\-training, and certification development.

* Partner with Sales and Project Management during estimating and planning to review project requirements, plans, specifications, equipment needs, labor assumptions, and commissioning requirements.
* Identify scope gaps, technical risks, site conditions, and execution challenges that could affect project cost, schedule, or successful delivery.

**Experience \& Education**


*Required*


* 10\+ years of experience installing or servicing fire suppression systems.
* 3\+ years’ leadership experience overseeing contractor teams in construction, industrial environments, or related industries.
* Demonstrated technical knowledge of fire suppression systems, installation practices, commissioning, troubleshooting, and field execution.
* Proficient knowledge of applicable NFPA standards.
* Strong mechanical aptitude with hands\-on experience involving tubing, piping, pressure testing, hand tools, and related field equipment.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and project specifications.

jobs.description:
**About Sycle**



Sycle is a market\-leading global SaaS company with the mission of facilitating the delivery of better hearing to the world. Founded in 2001, we have grown to be the leading practice management solution for audiology (hearing care) providers, with more than 65% market share. The Sycle practice management solution frees up valuable time so our customers can grow their businesses through delivering high quality patient care and exceptional services that delight their customers. Small hearing care practices and some of the largest retailers utilize our software in 13 countries worldwide.



The Sycle team is 120 strong. We are headquartered in Lone Tree, Colorado with a large remote workforce across the US and Canada. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to help us build and deliver market\-leading tools that make a difference for our customers. Check out our job listings and apply! This role is open to candidates in Colorado, California, Oregon and Washington.


**Position Overview**



Sycle is seeking a highly analytical and technical **Technical Business Analyst** to partner directly with our Product Management team on a high\-stakes enterprise account. In this role, you will get deep into the technical weeds—investigating legacy software systems, analyzing complex workflows, mapping out data, and translating detailed findings into clear recommendations for engineering and client stakeholders.



This role is critical in helping a major enterprise client transition from a heavily customized, legacy system onto Sycle’s modern SaaS platform. You will serve as the engine behind workflow mapping and system investigation while keeping cross\-functional teams organized and delivery on schedule.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Systems \& Workflow Analysis:** Perform detailed mapping of clinical, ordering, purchasing, and operational workflows across both "as\-is" legacy environments and "to\-be" SaaS platform states.
* **Deep Data \& System Investigation:** Independently investigate complex technical problems, conduct deep data analysis, write database queries, establish KPIs, and analyze system behaviors with minimal guidance.
* **Scrum Facilitation \& Agile Delivery:** Own and facilitate key Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, and demos to ensure predictable team delivery.
* **Technical Documentation:** Author high\-quality documentation that bridges high\-level business goals and granular technical requirements, tailoring communication for both technical teams and client executives.
* **Project Ownership \& Organization:** Maintain project artifacts, track risks, dependencies, and decisions, and proactively collaborate with Engineering to obtain and validate updates.
* **AI\-Enabled Productivity:** Leverage modern AI tools to streamline research, documentation, data analysis, and daily workflows to accelerate delivery speed.

jobs.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**


At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**


When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**


ModMed is hiring a driven Patient Services Trainer who will play a pivotal role in shaping a positive team and patient experience within our passionate, high\-performing Revenue Cycle Management team. As a critical team member, you will provide training and workshops to Patient Services Specialists of all levels, including onboarding new hires, nesting coaches, quality assurance specialists, and senior and lead specialists. You will work closely with Supervisors and other trainers to develop and update training curriculum, training resources and tools, and workshop materials to ensure that patient service trainee needs are met and effectively evaluated. This direct contribution to our team's development makes you an integral part of ModMed's business and opens the door to an exhilarating career path within a fast\-paced Healthcare IT company that is genuinely Modernizing Medicine!

* Serve as a point of contact to ensure internal teams' daily workflow processes are completed and supported, providing a strong floor presence.
* Explore and utilize new tools, resource applications, and AI to improve, enhance, and evaluate the onboarding process for new hires and existing team members.
* Communicate effectively with onshore and offshore teams (including those in the Philippines) and external consultants to support global training needs.
* Identify when new hires require additional support or are struggling to meet role expectations and escalate findings appropriately to leadership.

**Skills \& Requirements:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent, or a combination of education and experience, required.
* Minimum 2–3 years of medical claims/billing and contact center experience required.
* Minimum 1 year of dedicated training experience required.
* Minimum 1 year of people leadership or operations leadership experience required.
* Minimum 1 year of reporting and data analysis experience required.
* Ability to do 50\-75% travel required
* If local to our Boca Raton office in South Florida, the ability to commute to our headquarters on a hybrid basis (required)
* Ability to train and lead workshops for groups ranging up to 30 team members onshore and up to 15 team members offshore.
* Strong communication, judgment, and decision\-making skills, including the ability to communicate challenging feedback and make sound decisions independently.
* Openness to exploring and adopting new processes, AI tools, and training applications.
* Professional demeanor with strong organizational and time\-management capabilities.

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

**United States**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
* 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
* Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
* Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
* Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
* Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
* Global presence and in\-person collaboration opportunities; dog\-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office\-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
* Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

**PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information

Pavilion Payments is seeking a Manager of Customer Success to lead and strengthen our Relationship Management function.



In this role, you’ll lead a team of experienced Relationship Managers across multiple regions and serve as a strategic partner to the VP of Customer Success. jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager – Multichannel (Remote)
jobs.description:
**About us:** 

Ascendant (ascendantbrands.com) is home to a quartet of consumer brands built on one idea: What matters most is made by hand. Alvin's tools have helped design professionals, students and makers get the line right since 1950\. Promptly Journals holds onto the moments that pass too quickly. Choose Friendship turns beads and string into connection. Vaporeze is aromatherapy you place by hand. In a world of screens engineered to hold people's attention, we make things that put something real in their hands – and we run the company the same way, as a small team of stewards, hands\-on with our brands and with everyone who supplies, sells or buys our products.

On this team, everyone owns a verb. Where others conceive, grow and engineer, as our Customer Experience Manager, you will champion. You'll advocate for everyone we serve – the grandmother buying her sixth Childhood History journal, the drafting student rush\-ordering a tool set for class, and the independent retailer ordering seasonally – and you'll own or help manage every relationship a modern consumer products company carries. That's range no college degree or big\-company job can hand you. If you're eager to develop it, and to put today's AI tools to work in the process, join us.

**What you'll be doing:** 

* Advocating for our customers – investigating who buys from us and why, voicing their interests as we weigh decisions, and warning us when we're misunderstanding or underserving them.
* Managing our external relationships, from independent store buyers and national online retailers to schools and other institutional buyers, and our fulfillment partner.
* Captaining order fulfillment through our 3PL partner – holding B2B and B2C order processing to benchmarks, troubleshooting what goes wrong, and ensuring that a customer with a question, an issue or a return gets a fast, human\-curated or delivered answer.
* Tracking each brand's peak sales seasons, coordinating the team's inventory and marketing schedule, and keeping execution on track.
* Helping to build the tools – sometimes a spreadsheet, sometimes an AI agent – with which we track and manage customer relationships, and contributing to our weekly reporting.
* Taking on more: As you document, automate and delegate a process you've mastered, you will be handed the next on a path that could lead to a brand management role.

**What we're looking for:** 

* An empathetic, patient listener who brings positive energy to imperfect situations.
* A quick learner and proven problem\-solver – resourceful enough to find the answer without waiting for someone to hand it to you.
* A clear, persuasive writer – much of this work happens in an inbox.
* Experience with Google Workspace tools and a belief in the wonder of spreadsheets.
* Fluency with today's AI tools expected; AI agent development know\-how a plus. We don't expect the expertise, just the will to develop it.
* Exposure to customer care, ecommerce and/or retail a plus.
* Willingness to travel 2\-4 times per year to connect with colleagues and attend industry events.

**Compensation / work\-life features:**

* $50,000 – $65,000 budgeted compensation range, depending on experience.
* Balance: 21 Renewal Fridays per year – a three\-day weekend roughly every other week; 9 paid company holidays, and untracked PTO.
* 401(k) plan with a 1:1 company match up to 4% of earnings.
* No employer\-sponsored group health coverage. Instead, we employ a broker to help you navigate individual options, such as ACA Marketplace plans.
* Discounted dental and vision plans.
* Company\-paid life insurance.
* Remote contributor\-supportive culture – work schedule flexibility, support for acquiring productivity tools.
* A collegial team with leaders to learn from across every function of a consumer products business.

The Vendor Network Development \& Operations Specialist will identify, qualify, and develop service providers across landscaping, snow removal, janitorial, exterior maintenance, and other commercial facilities\-service categories.

The objective is to continuously build competitive regional coverage, compare qualified options, strengthen network depth, and identify the best long\-term service solution based on pricing, capabilities, reliability, geographic coverage, and client requirements.

This individual must be able to move quickly when large opportunities, urgent service requests, provider cancellations, or compressed bidding timelines arise. Strong candidates will combine urgency with sound judgment, organization, persistence, and commercial awareness.

**Note:** This role requires **occasional weekend availability** to support urgent client needs and time\-sensitive operational requests.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining consistently available and responsive.

jobs.description:
The Office Manager is responsible for managing the day\-to\-day operational workflow of an assigned office, ensuring files are handled efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs), department procedures, best practices, and divisional objectives. This role oversees the movement of work from assignment intake through appraiser handling, office review, and final return to the client.



The Office Manager plays a critical role in maintaining timely and professional client communication, ensuring diary updates, file notes, missing information requests, and client\-facing responses are completed accurately and within expected timelines. This position is responsible for monitoring office workflow, supporting appraiser production, identifying file delays or process gaps, and ensuring completed work products meet quality, documentation, and client\-specific handling requirements before final delivery.



The Office Manager also coordinates with Appraisers, Regional Field Managers, Operations leadership, Resource Management, Compliance, Training, and other support teams to maintain SLA adherence, resolve workflow issues, and support consistent execution of operational standards. The role requires strong organization, communication, follow\-through, and the ability to manage multiple file priorities while maintaining service quality and client responsiveness.

* People management: An Office Unit Manager needs to have excellent people management skills, including the ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members to ensure that they are performing at their best and delivering high\-quality work.

jobs.description:
Azenta Inc.
### **At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.**

**All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity**

**Job Title**
-------------

Account Manager
**Job Description**
-------------------

Title: Account Manager


Location: Remote – US


**Company Overview**

At GENEWIZ by Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer\-focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.


As a global leader in R\&D genomics services, GENEWIZ, leads the way in providing superior data quality with unparalleled technical support to enable researchers around the world to advance their scientific discoveries faster than ever before.  

  



Our customers at top\-tier pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and academic institutions, as well as cutting\-edge start\-ups, rely on our proprietary technologies for consistent, reliable, high\-quality data, even on the most difficult projects. A full\-service provider, we provides Sanger DNA sequencing, gene synthesis, molecular biology, high throughput/next generation sequencing, bioinformatics, and GLP regulatory services.  

  



**How You Will Add Value**

The Account Manager provides sales expertise and account management for the given territory (SW2 supporting Southern California outside of San Diego) supporting business aleading all selling and commercial activities within existing and prospective markets for the multiomics and synthetic biology portfolio. This Account Manager maintains effective customer relations, develops opportunities for growth within the territory, and assures market penetration and profitability while achieving sales targets.  

  



**What You Will Do**

* The Account Manager (1\) handles sales/account management activities for all assigned locations, defining and driving sales strategies, ensuring the achievement of bookings, revenue, and business goals (2\) owns and drives the territory development plan for the assigned sales territories and work collaboratively with stakeholders and coordinates resources across different areas to effectively drive team selling.
* Deliver impactful outcomes by leveraging a deep understanding and experience in navigating typical workflows within drug discovery, drug development, gene\-to\-antibody, and proteomics. Utilize consultative selling techniques to add value, drawing upon expertise in life science portfolios. Innovate and develop unique products and services tailored to address the specific needs of our customers.
* Consistently exceed quarterly and annual sales targets and quotas by proactively building and managing a robust sales pipeline. Drive growth by acquiring new customers / new accounts and expanding market penetration within existing accounts.
* Provide forecasts, weekly reports, marketing intelligence and information to managers and other stakeholders as the need arises.
* Proficient in closing sales deals through a strategic approach, coupled with strong skills in effective account management to nurture and maintain long\-term client relationships, ultimately driving business growth and retention.
* Effectively manage and maintain customer and account information, along with a clean, organized sales opportunities pipeline, tasks, and collaborative efforts within our CRM system. This ensures accurate visibility, tracking of customer interactions and streamlined sales processes.
* Collaborate extensively within a dynamic team environment to deliver customer\-centric value, driving revenue growth. Foster cross\-functional partnerships with teams such as Marketing, Product Development, Customer Service, Regional Sales Specialists, Technical Support, and Product Management. Ensure seamless resource collaboration to align strategies, execute sales initiatives, devise marketing plans, organize local vendor shows, implement campaigns, and effectively address customer needs.

**What You Will Bring**

* Minimum required education: Bachelor's Degree in a Life Sciences field.
* 3\+ years of relevant Genomics or Synthetic Biology experience in a commercial role with a proven track record of success in account management, exceeding targets and driving revenue growth.
* Strong understanding of the Genomics industry challenges is needed and ability to develop high level of applications knowledge based on industry and segment focus (Biotech, Government Agencies and Academia). Familiarity with most common Sequencing, Synthetic Biology, cell and gene therapies, and molecular biology lab techniques.
* Experience working in a team environment.
* Demonstrated history of devising and implementing successful strategies utilizing a consultative approach in customer interactions, resulting in measurable and impactful outcomes
* Negotiation skills, both in written and oral communication, coupled with presentation abilities. Proven track record of collaborating seamlessly with key stakeholders across internal and external organizations.
* Proficient in maintaining and organizing opportunity pipelines, tasks, and events using CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar platforms. Proficiency in computer skills, including a strong command of commonly used Microsoft Office applications, ensuring efficient and effective utilization of technology in daily tasks and responsibilities.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.

**Working Conditions/ Schedule**

* Requires the ability and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory for customer meetings, internal business gatherings, seminars, and conferences ((SW2 supporting Southern California outside of San Diego).

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
#### **About the Role**


At Xtremepush, we enable companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships by delivering exceptional technology, expertise, and customer service. As a leading provider of customer engagement solutions, our mission is to empower businesses to create meaningful, personalised experiences for their audiences.  

  

Due to rapid growth, we’re seeking an Account Manager to join our high\-performing team. In this role, you will be pivotal in fostering long\-term, trusted partnerships with some of our most valuable customers. By driving revenue retention and growth through relationship building, cross\-selling, and upselling, you’ll directly contribute to our company’s success.  

  

As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers achieve exceptional outcomes through our platform. By leveraging your expertise and interpersonal skills, you’ll help them realise the full value of their investment, fostering product adoption, expansion, and retention.  

  

This is a hybrid role. \#LI\-Hybrid

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Account Management \& Relationship Development:*** Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
* Build and nurture long\-lasting client relationships, maintaining regular and proactive communication.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to discuss performance, align on strategic goals, and plan upcoming initiatives.
* Cultivate trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

**Business Development:*** Identify and present opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling.
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements.

**Reporting \& Operations:*** Manage client interactions and track progress meticulously using HubSpot.
* Prepare and present detailed account status reports.
* Forecast and track critical account metrics, such as sales performance and annual revenue projections.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end management of RFPs, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.

**Client Partnership:*** Act as a client advocate, ensuring their needs and feedback are effectively communicated across teams.
* Collaborate with internal departments to develop and implement strategies that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Address client concerns promptly and escalate complex issues as necessary.
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of solutions that align with customer objectives.

#### **Your Experience and Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, Customer Success Manager or relevant role
* Have at least 2 years experience in a tech / SaaS company
* Experience working in the sports, betting and gaming industry
* Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation, including executive and C\-level
* Experience delivering client\-focused solutions to customer needs
* Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
* Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation abilities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Familiar with SaaS customer management or have a background in data with a flair for client communication and understand consumer behaviour is desirable
* Additional language is desirable

#### **Location**


This is a hybrid role based in North America. \#LI\-Hybrid

#### **About us**


Headquartered in Ireland with offices in the UK and US, Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built\-in CDP. It enables high\-velocity companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships through personalised, relevant, and timely communication. With a true single customer view at its core, Xtremepush provides actionable customer intelligence that drives engagement, conversion, and revenue across all channels, while putting customer retention first.  

  

*At Xtremepush, we believe that diversity adds incredible value to our teams, our products, and our culture. We don’t just accept differences, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our mission by ensuring that our place can be anyone’s place regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.*

jobs.description:
Total Expert is the Customer Operating System for financial services. Our purpose\-built platform combines a system of context with a system of action that enables humans and AI Assistants to engage in the moments that matter and earn customers for life. Since 2016 Total Expert has enabled more than seven trillion dollars of funded loan volume.

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) at Total Expert is a trusted partner to our financial services customers, helping them maximize the value of the platform through strategic guidance, technical enablement, and ongoing optimization. TAMs serve by combining product expertise with a deep understanding of customer goals, business context, and technology landscape.



This role bridges the gap between strategic vision and practical execution, delivering consistent, high\-quality engagements that are grounded in best\-practices that will drive adoption, operational efficiency, and measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a proactive, service\-minded approach and is energized by the opportunity to help customers make critical financial decisions that shape their lives.


***For candidates based in the Dallas, TX or Minneapolis, MN area, the position follows a hybrid schedule with 3 on\-site days per week. This position would be remote for qualifying candidates residing outside of those areas.***


**What you’ll be doing:**



Feature Adoption \& Platform Strategy


* Be the technical expert on customer use cases, configuration and tech stack
* Deliver structured, outcome\-focused engagements that drive platform usage and customer value
* Identify and guide expansion and optimization opportunities as customer needs evolve
* Conduct usage reviews and platform audits to maximize ROI/value
* Lead strategic conversations with Customer to align business objectives with platform execution
* Provide actionable recommendations based on data insights, technical design, and industry best practices, taking said action on behalf of the customer, where possible
* Document the project, including requirements, actions, outcomes and ROI\-related deliverables


Stakeholder Collaboration \& Advocacy


* Partner with CSMs and Customers to build mutually agreed\-upon success plans that drive high\-value engagements, resulting in retention and growth
* Advocate internally for customer needs and serve as a voice to Product and Engineering teams
* Participate in strategic planning, roadmap discussions, and Executive Business Reviews
* Maintain detailed records of account activity and engagement history in CS tools


Internal Enablement \& Continuous Improvement


* Share field insights, scalable solutions, and best practices across the organization
* Contribute to improving delivery playbooks, engagement models, and consulting frameworks
* Help refine internal processes to ensure TAM activities are efficient, impactful, and measurable
* Occasional travel may be required for strategic customer engagements


**What we are looking for:**


* Ability to operate independently with a proactive, customer\-first mindset
* Bias for action and urgency
* Passion for helping organizations adopt technology and achieve measurable success
* Experience working with multi\-stakeholder, enterprise accounts in complex industries
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills—capable of translating strategy into action
* Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities within a dynamic environment
* Excellent organization, time management, and documentation skills
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and process documentation


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* 3\+ years in a Technical Account Management, Implementation, or Customer Success role
* Experience supporting financial institutions, mortgage lenders, or fintech companies
* Familiarity with Mortgage Tech (LOS, POS, PPE, CRM), APIs, BI tools, and data integration models
* Background in a Saas billable utilization framework, delivering structured customer engagements with measurable outcomes


**Compensation/Benefits:** The anticipated base salary range for this role is $85,000 \- $95,000 annually. Final total compensation offered is dependent upon the selected individual's qualifications and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on company performance and other factors. As an employee of the company, you will be eligible to participate in the Employee Stock Option Plan. Total Expert offers a competitive range of benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA (Health Savings Account), FSA (Flexible Spending Accounts), company paid Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, Flexible Time\-Off (FTO), Paid Parental Leave, and 401(k) with employer match.

jobs.title: Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager, Full-time)
jobs.description:
**Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager)**
===============================================

**Full\-time \| Remote****Who We Are**
--------------


Prepory is a premier college admissions counseling company. Our innovative, holistic approach is reshaping how students apply to college, find their fit, and earn admission to their dream schools. We've guided more than 20,000 students across 80\+ countries, and we routinely help our students earn admission to the nation's most selective colleges and universities.  

Through our college admissions practice, we work one\-on\-one with students from as early as 8th grade, helping them build an intentional extracurricular profile, craft compelling essays, and navigate every step of the application process. We hold ourselves to an excellent record of success by gearing our services to genuinely counsel the students, families, and institutions we serve.**About This Role**
-------------------


The Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager) is the person our parents hear from most. You'll own the relationship between Prepory and the parents and guardians of the students we serve, from the orientation calls through final admissions decisions, and you'll make sure the experience a family signed up for is the experience they actually get.  

This is a client\-facing, relationship\-driven role. You'll run new student orientations and parent check\-in meetings, serve as the escalation point when a family's expectations and a coach's approach fall out of alignment, and mentor our college admissions coaches on how to navigate hard conversations and complicated family dynamics. When a family is ready to add programming or re\-enroll for another year, you'll be the person they trust enough to ask.  

You'll also maintain a cohort of up to 15 students. That caseload is deliberately small, because the majority of your hours belong to client success. Coaching a few students keeps you close to the advising experience you represent to parents every day.  

You'll report to our Client Success Director and work alongside our Program Directors, Program Managers, Enrollment team, and coaching team. **What You'll Do**

### **Own the family relationship**

* Conduct new student orientation sessions that set clear expectations for the program and each family's role in it.
* Run parent check\-in meetings alongside the student's coach, translating student progress into terms families understand and can act on.
* Communicate proactively with parents and guardians so concerns surface early, while there's still time to solve them.
* Serve as the point of escalation for families whose expectations, needs, or dynamics call for a steadier hand, and know when to bring in the Client Success Director.
* Handle difficult conversations with disappointed or anxious families directly, calmly, and with a solutions\-oriented attitude.

### **Support and protect the coaching relationship**

* Serve as the point of contact and escalation for college admissions coaches navigating client concerns, expectations, and family dynamics.
* Mentor coaches on client communication, individualized student needs, and the situations that don't have a playbook.
* Collaborate with coaches and program leadership to adjust programming when a student's needs change.

### **Grow the relationship**

* Recognize when a family is ready for more, and introduce the Prepory programming that fits: college tours, UK admissions support, graduate and professional school admissions, and enrichment and research planning.
* Own re\-enrollments for the families you serve, and carry the commercial conversation with the same care you bring to every other conversation.
* Champion referral and review strategies, including mentoring coaches on leveraging their relationship with families to drive positive reviews and referrals to friends and family.

### **Coach a cohort of up to 15 students**

* Conduct regular one\-on\-one advising sessions with your students, from profile building through final decisions.
* Advise students through the writing process for personal statements, supplemental essays, and résumés, providing meaningful, actionable feedback.
* Track each student's deadlines and assign tasks between sessions to keep them on pace.
* Help students research and build a balanced college list that reflects their academic and professional interests.

 **What You Bring**

* Admissions knowledge you can draw on in real time. You'll be on live calls with families who ask hard, specific questions. You need to answer most of them with confidence, and recognize the rest quickly enough to say you'll follow up rather than guess.
* Composure with any family in the room. Orientations and check\-ins put you in front of every kind of parent, from the entirely hands\-off to the deeply anxious.
* Real comfort with the commercial side of the work. We are looking for someone who is excited when a conversation turns to renewals, add\-on programming, or enrolling a second child, and who treats it as the natural extension of a relationship they've earned.
* Availability to work at least one evening per week and 12 Saturdays or Sundays per year.
* Impeccable listening, speaking, writing, and grammar skills, along with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-moving environment, including peak season, when orientations, check\-ins, and application deadlines all land at once.

**Qualifications of Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------------------------

* Graduated from a selective or highly\-selective college or university (top\-50 national university or top\-20 liberal arts college preferred).
* Three or more years of experience in college admissions, admissions consulting, or a closely related field. Experience inside an admissions office is a strong plus.
* Detailed, current knowledge of the U.S. college admissions process, and a willingness to stay current

Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. **Part\-Time HR Generalist, Client Services**
RCR Consulting Group \| Fully Remote \| 25\-30 hours per week, Monday\-Friday \| $32\.00\-$40\.00 per hour

**The Opportunity**
===================


RCR Consulting Group is looking for a hands\-on HR generalist who genuinely likes doing the work — not just advising on it.  

  

You will support a portfolio of small and mid\-size client organizations across a wide range of industries, and no two days look the same. One morning you are drafting an offer letter and running a background check. That afternoon you are putting together an FMLA designation notice, then jumping on a call to walk a client's payroll administrator through a deduction correction. Next week you are deep in a new HRIS implementation, cleaning up employee data and testing the first payroll run.  

  

If that variety sounds energizing rather than scattered, keep reading. If your instinct is that this work should be handed to someone else, this is not the right fit — and we would rather both of us know that now.  

This is a permanent part\-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who wants RCR to be their work — not a side engagement alongside other employment or their own consulting practice.**The Schedule**
================


Core hours are **9:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Eastern**, when we need you reachable for clients. The remaining hours each week are yours to place — early mornings, evenings, whatever fits your life. We hold this schedule seriously; it is the reason the role exists as part\-time rather than full\-time.  

  

We do ask for flexibility to pick up additional hours occasionally when client needs spike — open enrollment, an implementation go\-live, an urgent employee relations matter.**A Note on Career Breaks**
===========================


We welcome applicants returning to the workforce after time away. A gap on your resume is not a mark against you here — we care that you have the experience and that you are ready to use it. If you stepped back from a career in HR and want back in, we would like to hear from you.**What You Will Actually Do**
=============================

*We wrote this section deliberately specific, because we want you to know exactly what you are signing up for.***Day\-to\-day HR execution — you do the work, not delegate it**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Draft and send offer letters, and manage onboarding paperwork, I\-9s, and background checks end to end
* Prepare FMLA, ADA, and state leave notices and correspondence, and track leave cases from first request through return to work
* Process and audit payroll: entering changes, chasing down discrepancies, reconciling deductions, resolving the check that came out $46 short
* Maintain accurate employee data across HRIS platforms — you are the one in the system, not the one reviewing a report about the system
* Build and update handbooks, policies, job descriptions, offer templates, and employee communications
* Run open enrollment logistics: employee meetings, election tracking, carrier file follow\-up, post\-enrollment audits

**Client service that earns the "wow"**
---------------------------------------

* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day HR contact for your clients — the person they call when something goes sideways
* Respond fast, follow through completely, and close the loop without being asked twice
* Handle a client's employee question with the same care whether it is a routine PTO balance or a resignation letter that just landed
* Anticipate what is coming — the I\-9 that expires next month, the notice that is due, the manager who will need coaching before that conversation

**Projects and systems implementations**
----------------------------------------

* Work implementations start to finish: data gathering and cleanup, configuration testing, parallel payroll runs, employee communications, go\-live support
* Manage several client projects at once and keep every one of them moving
* Document processes so the next person can run them

**Employee relations and manager support**
------------------------------------------

* Investigate and resolve employee relations matters — complaints, performance concerns, policy violations — with discretion and clean documentation
* Coach frontline and mid\-level managers through performance conversations, write\-ups, and terminations
* Keep clients compliant with federal and state employment law: FMLA, ADA, FLSA, ACA, and the multi\-state patchwork that comes with our client base

**Who Thrives Here**
====================

* You would rather have twelve things on your plate than three, and you have a system for keeping all of them straight
* You get bored when work gets repetitive, and you look for the next problem to solve
* You take real pride in being the person a client can count on — responsiveness is part of your professional identity, not a requirement someone imposed on you
* You are comfortable being the one who does the task, files the form, fixes the record, and sends the email
* You are steady when three clients need you at once and one of them is upset
* You are detail\-obsessed. A wrong date on a leave notice or a typo in an offer letter bothers you

**Who This Is Not For**
=======================

*We say this plainly because false starts are expensive for everyone:** **You are looking for advisory\-only or strategy\-only work.** Roughly 70% of this job is execution. If you want to build the framework and hand it off, this will frustrate you.
* **You want to lead a team.** There is no team to lead. You are an individual contributor, and you will stay one.

**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**

* Manage project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, (Return for Information), and meeting minutes.

* Responsible for the assembly and timely delivery of the Owner and Maintenance Manuals.

* Interacts with subcontractors to ensure we have obtained the correct documentation and drawing for the Owner and Maintenance Manuals.

* Attend company/project meetings with clients, subcontractors, etc., and provide project management support
* Cooperate with and technically assist field personnel assigned to the area of responsibility.
* Monitor other contractors' activities and progress.

* Prepares price change orders and project reports and documentation.
* Works with payroll to ensure accurate payroll information.

--------------------------------------

* Knowledge of construction technology, scheduling, equipment, and methods required
* Tactful and has a professional demeanor, and ability to interact effectively with managers, employees, vendors, and others

* Strong attention to details
* Demonstrated excellence in organization and time management skills
* Identify and meet customers' expectations and requirements
* Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.); Oracle preferred
* Prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary
* Work under pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude

* Self\-motivated, proactive, and an effective team player
* Interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others


**WHAT YOU BRING TO US:**
-------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or related field
* Minimum 1 year of experience in a construction\-related role
* Can be a combination of training, education, and relevant work experience that is equivalent


**TRAVEL:**

* Up to 25%


**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* General work environment \- This position is performed primarily on active construction sites. Activity includes sitting for extended periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning.
