new_jobs.title: Senior Analyst / Manager, Sales Operations & Deal Desk
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



ID.me is the next\-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70\+ healthcare organizations. More than 600\+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me's technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800\-63\-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to "No Identity Left Behind" to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.



ID.me is a full\-time, in\-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on\-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field\-based sales or other remote\-by\-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.



At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

**About the Role**



ID.me is hiring a Manager of Sales Operations \& Deal Desk to be the operational engine behind our sales process — from pipeline hygiene and CRM administration to deal structuring and approvals. This role sits within Revenue Operations and is the day\-to\-day partner Sales reps and managers turn to for anything that touches process, systems, or deal terms. Given ID.me's consumption\-based pricing model, deals often involve non\-standard structures — usage tiers, ramp schedules, minimum commitments — that require careful review and consistent governance. This role is a strong fit for someone who's detail\-oriented, systems\-fluent, and energized by being the person who keeps sales moving efficiently without sacrificing deal quality or compliance.  

Level (Senior Analyst vs. Manager) will be determined based on the candidate's experience.


**Why This Role Matters**



Sales Operations \& Deal Desk is where strategy meets execution — every deal that closes efficiently and every clean pipeline report starts here. This role gives you direct, visible impact on how quickly and effectively ID.me's sales team can operate.


**What You'll Do**



Deal Desk


* Review and approve deal structures, pricing exceptions, discounting, and non\-standard contract terms in line with company policy
* Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance to structure deals for ID.me's consumption\-based pricing model — usage tiers, minimum commitments, ramp schedules, and renewal terms
* Maintain deal desk approval workflows and playbooks, ensuring consistent turnaround times and clear escalation paths
* Track and report on deal desk cycle time, exception volume, and win/loss patterns tied to deal structure


Sales Operations


* Own CRM data integrity and administration (Salesforce): pipeline hygiene, opportunity stages, fields, and reporting structure
* Support territory design, account assignment, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales leadership
* Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting for pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity
* Identify and implement process improvements across the quote\-to\-cash lifecycle, reducing friction for reps and improving data quality for Finance


Cross\-Functional Partnership


* Act as the go\-to resource for sales reps and managers on process, systems, and deal questions
* Partner with Finance/FP\&A to ensure deal terms and CRM data flow cleanly into revenue reporting and forecasting
* Support onboarding and training for new sales hires on CRM usage, deal desk process, and sales tools
* Assist with ad hoc analysis and projects as Revenue Operations scales


**What You'll Bring**


* 3\+ years (Senior Analyst) or 5\+ years (Manager) of experience in sales operations, deal desk, or a related analytical function, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce (or comparable CRM) — administration, reporting, and workflow configuration
* Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills; comfort building clean, reliable analysis under time pressure
* High attention to detail and a process\-oriented mindset — comfortable being the person who enforces consistency
* Clear communicator who can explain policy and process to sales reps without being a bottleneck
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where process is still being built


**Nice to Have**


* Experience with deal structuring for consumption/usage\-based pricing models \- Experience with CPQ tools or quote\-to\-cash process design
* Exposure to sales compensation, territory planning, or forecasting

All ID.me employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling our commitment to equal employment opportunity. **ABOUT THE LYCÉE FRANÇAIS DE SAN FRANCISCO**


The Lycée Français de San Francisco (the Lycée) is a French immersion and International College Preparatory
  

school with 820\+ students across three Bay Area campuses. The Lycée strives to maintain an international

rich educational environment that emphasizes academic excellence and personal achievement.

Hallcon is a transportation and related infrastructure services company that serves clients such as technology companies, manufacturers, railroads, universities, corporate business parks, hospitals, airports, public transportation networks and more.
  
  

Hallcon provides essential services spanning multi\-modal operations, integrated command centers, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, technology integration, analytics, business intelligence, fleet management, specialty cleaning, and overall rider experience performance. We are inviting the right leader to join our team and help us drive rapid growth.
  
  

The Role
  
The Supervisor supports daily transportation operations by serving as a central point of communication between customers, drivers, maintenance, and management. This role involves monitoring events, logging and filtering information for reporting, tracking ridership data, and handling various administrative tasks. The Supervisor ensures that all activities are documented accurately, communicated clearly, and handled promptly.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Coordinate daily operations by working with Operations Managers and drivers, ensuring professional communication across all levels.
* Manage yard logistics, including assigning parking stalls and electric bus chargers, and working with the maintenance team to schedule bus repairs and preventative maintenance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for drivers reporting events, incidents, or emergencies, responding quickly and appropriately with sound judgment.
* Document and manage all incidents and customer complaints per client standards, escalating complex issues as necessary.
* Prepare and distribute time\-sensitive client reports, filtering daily events into concise, actionable information.
* Perform essential administrative duties, including manual data entry, record keeping, and tracking daily ridership data.
* Utilize Excel and Outlook for all operational reporting, scheduling, and correspondence needs.
* Ensure safety and compliance by performing field inspections (bus and driver), auditing driver vehicle inspection reports, and driver daily run reports.
* Key responsibilities are subject to change based on evolving business needs.
* Serve as back up driver in the event business and staffing needs require a backup driver.
* Knowledgeable of DOT regulations.


Qualifications, Experience and Education
  
* Possession of Commercial Driver License (CDL) B with Airbrake and Passenger Endorsement
* Must have a minimum of 1 year of commercial driving experience
* Must have and maintain a current DOT Medical Certificate
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick decision\-making ability under pressure.
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
* Experience in an office or operations setting preferred.
* Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Prior experience in transportation, dispatch, or a similar administrative role is an asset.


We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, exceptional growth potential and stability, all within a professional, yet casual work environment.

Hallcon is a transportation and related infrastructure services company that serves clients such as technology companies, manufacturers, railroads, universities, corporate business parks, hospitals, airports, public transportation networks and more.
  
  

Hallcon provides essential services spanning multi\-modal operations, integrated command centers, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, technology integration, analytics, business intelligence, fleet management, specialty cleaning, and overall rider experience performance. We are inviting the right leader to join our team and help us drive rapid growth.
  
  

The Role
  
The Supervisor supports daily transportation operations by serving as a central point of communication between customers, drivers, maintenance, and management. This role involves monitoring events, logging and filtering information for reporting, tracking ridership data, and handling various administrative tasks. The Supervisor ensures that all activities are documented accurately, communicated clearly, and handled promptly.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Coordinate daily operations by working with Operations Managers and drivers, ensuring professional communication across all levels.
* Manage yard logistics, including assigning parking stalls and electric bus chargers, and working with the maintenance team to schedule bus repairs and preventative maintenance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for drivers reporting events, incidents, or emergencies, responding quickly and appropriately with sound judgment.
* Document and manage all incidents and customer complaints per client standards, escalating complex issues as necessary.
* Prepare and distribute time\-sensitive client reports, filtering daily events into concise, actionable information.
* Perform essential administrative duties, including manual data entry, record keeping, and tracking daily ridership data.
* Utilize Excel and Outlook for all operational reporting, scheduling, and correspondence needs.
* Ensure safety and compliance by performing field inspections (bus and driver), auditing driver vehicle inspection reports, and driver daily run reports.
* Key responsibilities are subject to change based on evolving business needs.
* Serve as back up driver in the event business and staffing needs require a backup driver.
* Knowledgeable of DOT regulations.


Qualifications, Experience and Education
  
* Possession of Commercial Driver License (CDL) B with Airbrake and Passenger Endorsement
* Must have a minimum of 1 year of commercial driving experience
* Must have and maintain a current DOT Medical Certificate
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick decision\-making ability under pressure.
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
* Experience in an office or operations setting preferred.
* Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Prior experience in transportation, dispatch, or a similar administrative role is an asset.


We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, exceptional growth potential and stability, all within a professional, yet casual work environment.
  
  

Hallcon is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
  
  

Hallcon is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Consumption Products
new_jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



Box is expanding into a new era of monetization, one that blends our trusted subscription model with dynamic, consumption\-based pricing for AI\-powered and Platform capabilities. As the Program Manager, Consumption Products, you will own the day\-to\-day operations of this early\-stage but high\-priority business, sitting at the intersection of product, finance, analytics, and our customer\-facing teams. This is a rare opportunity to build something new at scale: you will help define how Box monetizes AI Units today and lay the operational foundation for expanding consumption\-based models across our Platform and beyond.



This role reports to the VP, Renewals and Consumption and carries direct visibility with Box's Chief Operating Officer and other senior leaders. You will work across an exceptionally diverse set of teams \- from Product Management and Data Engineering to Billing, Marketing, and Account Teams serving as the connective tissue that keeps this fast\-moving program running accurately and efficiently.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



You will own the customer\-facing consumption program at Box globally. As the owner, you will:


* Monitor daily customer consumption, overage trends, and program activity, identifying accounts that require action and driving unresolved issues to closure.
* Coordinate and execute operational actions including exception handling, managing customer controls, advising on account\-specific treatments, and providing validated data for periodic customer reporting and billing.
* Serve as the first\-line subject matter expert for consumption billing questions from Account Teams and GTM stakeholders, providing timely guidance on program mechanics, alerts, and commercial considerations.
* Work with Business Analytics and Product teams to investigate new usage patterns and new reporting capabilities, translating business requirements into clear, actionable requests for analysts and data specialists.
* Review product updates and policy changes to assess operational impact, and contribute to internal playbooks, FAQs, and customer\-facing guidance.
* Act as the cross\-functional orchestrator across work\-streams converting ambiguous problems into clear decisions, owners, and action plans — while maintaining an integrated view of dependencies across product, billing, analytics, marketing, and customer communications.
* Lead the expansion of consumption billing to new products at Box


**WHO YOU ARE**



You love building from scratch and leaving your mark. You are someone who excitedly brings structure to chaos, with the ability to connect disparate dots and discern signal from noise. You are incredibly detail oriented with a "GSD" mindset, while always keeping the big picture in mind. Where others see problems, you see solutions. You always put the customer in the center of your decision making. If this sounds like you, you also likely have the following experience:


* You have 4\+ years of experience in management consulting, program management, operations, or a cross\-functional business role, ideally within a consulting firm, SaaS or technology company.
* You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and familiarity with consumption\-based or usage\-based pricing, including AI\-driven products.
* You have clearly demonstrated quantitative analysis experience, comfortably bring able to perform moderate analyses' and interpreting data prepared by others
* You communicate clearly and concisely in both written and verbal form, with the ability to simplify complex policies, workflows, and commercial terms for diverse audiences.
* You have strong attention to detail when handling customer\-specific terms, exceptions, alerts, and operational actions.


Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. **About Visions**



Visions Management began in 2007 with the goal to reimagine the experience of move management, space planning and FF\&E services for our clients. To meet this goal, we built a diverse team of experts from varied backgrounds. Visons is a Certified Women Business Enterprise, Small Business, San Francisco Local Business Enterprise and EcoVadis Gold Medalist (Universal Sustainability Award).



We believe company culture is key to the professional and personal growth of our employees. Visions Management is committed to inspiring our people as a family first company offering an environment that promotes continued education, training, coaching, creativity and bringing ideas to life.



We look forward to learning about you!  

  

**About the Team**



Visions’ embedded teams work onsite supporting their client with a variety of services, including move management, event support, space and occupancy planning and more. Team members are uniquely positioned to work within their client’s systems and processes, while delivering the excellent service and results that are emblematic of Visions. The employees who make up the Embedded vertical rise to meet the challenge of representing the excellence of Visions for their client.

 **About the Role**



The Workplace Readiness Project Manager supports the planning, coordination, and execution of workplace projects and transition initiatives, with a focus on People \& Culture (P\&C), Front Office operations, employee experience, and workplace readiness.



This role serves as a key coordination point across project teams, internal stakeholders, vendors, and employees to ensure workplace initiatives are organized, well communicated, and successfully executed. The Workplace Readiness Project Manager will manage project documentation and schedules, coordinate operational readiness and move activities, support employee communications and engagement, and help drive projects from planning through go\-live.

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and collaborative, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the creativity to develop practical solutions that enhance the workplace and employee experience.

 **Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Management**


* Coordinate project plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, decisions, deliverables, and action items across P\&C and Front Office workstreams.
* Coordinate stakeholders and facilitate project meetings, ensuring decisions, responsibilities, and next steps are clearly documented and communicated.
* Gather and synthesize stakeholder feedback, identify gaps or potential issues, and coordinate resolution with project leadership.
* Prepare status reports, readiness updates, executive summaries, and other project communications.
* Maintain accountability across stakeholders and workstreams to support timely completion of project deliverables.
* Manage and coordinate external vendors, including schedules, deliverables, responsibilities, follow\-up, and issue resolution.

  


**Workplace Readiness \& Operations**


* Coordinate workplace readiness activities for Front Office spaces, shared amenities, workplace services, and other employee\-facing operational needs.
* Support the development and implementation of workplace procedures, service standards, operational guidelines, and readiness plans.
* Develop, document, and help establish workplace best practices, processes, and service standards that support efficient and consistent operations.
* Coordinate vendors, responsible owners, testing, walkthroughs, punch\-list items, and operational handoffs leading up to go\-live.
* Support furniture\-related planning and coordination, including understanding furniture layouts, employee needs, installation requirements, and readiness of workspaces and shared areas.
* Help ensure spaces, services, and operational processes are prepared for a successful employee transition.
* Apply creativity and problem\-solving to workplace challenges, identifying solutions that balance functionality, employee experience, operational needs, and project requirements.

  


**Employee Communications \& Engagement**


* Support the development and coordination of employee communications, FAQs, guides, orientation materials, and move\-related resources.
* Draft clear, polished employee communications, workplace processes, procedures, guides, and other written materials for a variety of audiences.
* Coordinate employee orientations, facility tours, go\-live activities, and engagement initiatives.
* Partner with P\&C, Marketing \& Communications, Workplace Strategy, and other stakeholders to create a consistent and positive employee transition experience.
* Help ensure employees have clear and timely information throughout workplace changes and transitions.

  


**Move \& Transition Coordination**


* Coordinate P\&C and Front Office clean\-out, inventory, packing, staging, and move\-readiness activities.
* Track employee, vendor, and workstream responsibilities related to relocation and transition activities.
* Support secure records relocation and other specialized move requirements.
* Coordinate with furniture, moving, facilities, and other workplace vendors to support installation, relocation, and operational readiness.
* Provide hands\-on coordination and onsite support during key move, transition, and go\-live periods.

* Conduct targeted research related to transportation, workplace services, employee experience, and other workplace transition needs.

new_jobs.title: Technology Services Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Join a Team Where Engineering Excellence Drives Opportunity
  
  

At Affiliated Engineers, Inc. (AEI), we bring together expertise and innovation to solve the most complex challenges. Since 1978, we’ve supported mission\-driven organizations in designing systems and environments that advance society and improve lives. Today, with more than 1000 professionals across 23 offices, we help shape the future of healthcare, science and technology, energy, education, and other vital sectors.
  
  

From elevating patient care in Mayo Clinic’s world\-class hospitals to enabling discovery in high\-containment laboratories for U.S. agencies and driving environmental progress with Microsoft’s renowned Thermal Energy Center, our work enriches the human experience, safeguards the environment, and pushes the boundaries of possibility.
  
  

AEI consistently earns national recognition from leading industry publications, including Building Design\+Construction, Engineering News\-Record, and Consulting\-Specifying Engineer, with distinctions such as being named the \#1 Laboratory Engineering Firm in the nation and receiving multiple Best of the Best Project awards, underscoring the lasting legacy of our work.
  
  

At AEI, you’ll join a collaborative community where your expertise fuels innovation, your ideas drive progress, and your work helps shape a brighter future.
  
  

As a Technology Services Project Manager in our San Diego office, you will help us empower our clients to achieve energy\-efficient building solutions, save global environments, and create a better, greener future for all.
  
  

**Here's Why We Need You:**  

In this role, you will lead major projects, develop client relationships, deliver projects according to client needs and budget, lead concept development of building systems, and guide a team of engineers from project conception though occupancy. Within this position, you will also participate in project interviews, providing high\-level client service, establishing long\-term partnerships, keeping abreast of market trends, and ensuring resolution of all technical and service issues.
  
  

**Expertise of our most successful Project Manager:**  

* BS in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering from an ABET accredited program.
* RCDD registration.
* 10\+ years in consulting environment designing building systems or leading design projects across MEP disciplines.
* Successful management of large and complex projects for sophisticated client’s healthcare, laboratory, infrastructure, higher education, industrial, or R\&D facilities.
* Demonstrated leadership on projects and with staff.
* Long history of very satisfied clients.


**Effective skills to help you flourish:**  

* Strong spoken and written communications skills.
* Excellent organization and time management skills.
* Quick technical comprehension and motivation focused on client outcomes.
* Able to effectively prioritize multiple tasks.
* Effective working individually and within team environments.


**When you work here, you can expect:**  

* A flexible, collaborative environment where your well\-being matters—because your best work happens when you’re supported.
* Real opportunities to grow—through mentorship, professional development programs, and exposure to high\-impact projects across disciplines.
* To collaborate with inspiring teammates who challenge the status quo, foster innovation, and pave the way for future leaders.
* A benefits package that offers health, dental, vision, and retirement, a performance\-based year\-end bonus, and thoughtful perks tailored to your needs—whether that's a flexible work environment, wellness resources, or community\-focused initiatives, we’ll continue to invest in.


If this dynamic environment and the chance to contribute to transformative projects resonate with your ambitions, we would love to connect with you. Join us and make an impact!
  
Apply online at https://aeieng.com/about/careers/
  
If you know someone who would thrive in this role, please share this posting with them directly via email or through your LinkedIn network.
  
AEI is proud to be an EEO/AA Employer/Vet/Disabled.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is seeking a Project Manager to oversee and coordinate the execution of successful new build infrastructure and expansion/retrofit projects in our Global Engineering, Maintenance, \& Sustainability (GEMS) Organization. This individual will lead a team of support personnel and coordinate the resources required to launch new and complex projects with the goals of achieving timelines, staying within budget, and driving standardization within our network. The Project Manager will manage medium to large capital projects with significant schedule commitments. The Project Manager will lead and coordinate schedule of multiple vendors at the same time, as well as interface at all levels of the organization.  

  

This role requires up to 80% nationwide travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage new and existing programs, successfully delivering difficult projects and goals across multiple organizations  

Partner with other program managers to secure resources, scope efforts, set project priorities and milestones and drive delivery

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician
new_jobs.description:
Title: QA Technician  
Full\-Time \| Non\-Exempt \| Hourly

POSITION OVERVIEW  
Location: Emeryville, CA (On\-site)  
Pay Rate: $24 \- $26/hour (Depending on experience)  
Department: Quality  
Reports To: QA Manager

Schedule:

Monday through Friday shifts: 4:00AM \- 12:30PM (Weekend availability a plus!)

OR

Saturday and Sunday shifts

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO \& Sick Leave

ABOUT PETIT POT  
Petit Pot is a growing food manufacturing company based in Emeryville, CA. We produce high\-quality French\-inspired desserts and are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, balancing purpose and profit while considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, community, and the environment.

POSITION SUMMARY  
The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring that all production paperwork is completed, collected, organized, reviewed, and filed to the satisfaction of all pertinent regulatory agencies and customers. Ensure the site is always audit\-ready by maintaining GMP, Organic, SQF, and any other certifications. Ensure the quality of all incoming ingredients, batches, and finished products. Perform required quality testing of products and records accurate product specifications in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of food safety protocols, quality control processes, and regulatory compliance in the food manufacturing industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all regulatory issues pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all customer requirements and preferences pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Collect all production paperwork, ensuring that any missing paperwork is located.  
\- Provide aggressive reporting and retraining for all incomplete, incorrect, or non\-compliant paperwork.  
\- Organize paperwork per established filing system.  
\- Review paperwork, ensuring that all process CCP’s, quality specifications, and customer requirements have been met. Any product affected by deviations or missing records must be reported to QA Manager and placed on QA hold.  
\- Manage filing systems such that all completed and reviewed records are maintained and accessible for the time required by customers and regulatory agencies.  
\- Release product.  
\- Provide assistance/support as needed with the customer, government, and third\-party audits.  
\- Ensure all products meet the customer and product requirements.  
\- Always keep all work areas and equipment within SQF standards and clean.  
\- Ensure all personal protective equipment is always properly worn.  
\- Ensure all equipment is set up, calibrated, and functioning properly throughout your shift.  
\- Keep all equipment that is used clean, in your area always, and prepared for the next run.  
\- Perform several checks to the batches such as Color, pH \& sensory, vacuum and % solid.  
\- Obtain batch samples by opening kettles, turning off agitators, ladle the samples, place samples in beakers, and take them to QC Bench for testing.  
\- Obtain liquid ingredient samples from bulk containers and perform testing on them.  
\- Recommend adjustments be made to batches by adding or subtracting ingredients.  
\- Monitor the Filler Machine and lines by checking the weights, charts, codes, labeling, pasteurizer temperatures and perform hourly finished product analysis.  
\- Verify codes and charts very closely \- the ink can run dry and codes can be set wrong.  
\- Perform visual checks and record results, weigh product on calibrated scales, obtain and bring the samples to the QC bench for testing, perform tests, and record results.  
\- Place batches of finished products on hold as required.  
\- Copy batch cards as required for kitchen operators.  
\- All other assigned duties required during your work period.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE  
\- GED or High School Diploma  
\- Previous QA experience in a food manufacturing environment.  
\- Ability to work with numbers, perform calculations, and possess mechanical abilities.  
\- Ability to identify food safety concerns or risks.  
\- Demonstrated ability to work independently, with limited supervision.  
\- Communication skills: must be able to communicate and work closely with all departments and management levels.  
\- Keep up with a fast\-paced work environment and record data as required in a timely manner.  
\- Extreme attention to detail.  
\- Strong organizational ability.  
\- Good communication skills (both written and verbal).  
\- General computer proficiency (Word, Excel, etc.).  
\- Ability to attend and successfully complete related training programs.  
\- Spanish (Plus, not required)

EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS USED  
\- Use the following equipment: Refractometer, Salt Titrator, Acid Titrator, PH Meter, Color Meter, Moisture Meter, Viscometer, and Consistometer, various gages, torque meters and other equipment as required.  
\- Handcarts and pallet jacks.  
\- Forklift (not all QC Techs.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
\- SQF Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- PCQI Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- HACCP Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- Experience in the food manufacturing industry required.  
\- Knowledge of food safety regulations, quality standards, and production best practices.  
\- Experience with lean manufacturing, process improvement, or waste reduction is a plus.  
\- Experience in dessert, dairy, pudding, or refrigerated food production is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  
\- Varied temperature work areas.  
\- The environment is very wet, slippery, and has continuous forklift traffic.  
\- Handle and work around various moving equipment and chemicals.  
\- Frequent use of hot/cold water to perform checks and clean equipment and area.  
\- Frequent lifting objects \< 30 lbs. and pushing/pulling of objec

new_jobs.title: Client Services Representative (Part Time)
new_jobs.description:
**About Pets in Need**

***Our mission is to provide animals with loving care and lasting homes, to partner with communities striving to do the same, and to advance our no\-kill legacy.***
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 **OVERVIEW**:This is a dynamic role that supports many programs at PIN and is primarily responsible for getting animals into homes. You are the first person that visitors meet upon emailing, calling or arriving at the shelter. Depending on the day, this could be in a group setting or a minimally supervised setting. Our CSR Team is driven to provide quality customer service, multitaskers, adaptable, goal\-oriented, creative and excited about bringing new ideas or programs to fruition to help save more lives

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


Client Services

* Greet all visitors, volunteers, staff or donors that enter the shelters.
* Treat all visitors with respect and courtesy, regardless of the reason they are seeking services. Respond to inquiries from clients in writing, over the phone, and in person in a professional manner. Provide support to clients in the community by answering inquiries with clear and accurate information about PIN programs, services, policies and municipal, county, or state animal ordinances.


\*Collect fees for PIN provided services. Solicit donations to support PIN monthly and annual fundraising goals. \*Create a comfortable and welcoming environment by keeping professional workspaces and lobbies free of clutter.


\*Attend onsite or off\-site events to advertise animals or the services PIN provides. Train staff and/or volunteers. \*As needed \- other duties will be assigned.


Adoption Counseling

* Clearly and concisely review an animal’s behavioral and medical history to accurately relay information to staff, potential adopters or volunteers.
* Facilitate adoptions by matchmaking animals with prospective adopters using a conversation\-based approach with the goal of finding the best possible outcome for the person and the animal. Become familiar with adoptable animals in the shelter and in foster homes; work hands\-on with animals and collaborate with matchmaker volunteers to conduct adoption meet\-and\-greets. Remove barriers to adoption and support inclusivity and equity in adoptions by following a progressive open adoptions model.
* Write appealing pet profiles to attract adopters, take photos or videos of animals and track animals that need photos to create a list for photography volunteers.
* Solicit post\-adoption updates and provide support to help keep animals in homes.


Animal Intake Process

* The intake of stray animals, which includes gathering information from the client, behaviorally assessing, vaccinating, microchipping and setting up housing.
* Track down information from microchipped or tagged strays to reunite pets with owners. Process return\-to\-owner paperwork and fees, and microchip animals that are being reclaimed. Track lost and found reports submitted by clients and reunite lost pets when matches are found.
* Process the intake of a variety of injured, sick, or underage wildlife, which includes handling and assessing animals and setting up housing. Process the surrender of an animal in an empathetic and compassionate manner and gather behavioral and medical history from clients.
* Process disposal and cremation requests, which include handling deceased animals. Feed and care for underage, orphaned kittens. Report medical and behavior concerns to the appropriate department.


 Community Outreach

* In collaboration with the Medical \& Outreach Team, greet clients and collect fees for Community Outreach related programs such as Community Spay \& Neuter, Community Vaccine Clinic, Community Veterinary Clinic, and Owner Requested Humane Euthanasia.
* Attend annual events such as Pet Care Assistance Day and Clear The Shelters.


Volunteer Engagement

* Act as a point\-person for volunteers at the shelter and assist with answering questions or redirecting volunteers to the appropriate person or department. As needed, help with the onboarding process for new volunteers, which includes teaching hands\-on animal handling classes, conducting orientations, and scheduling volunteers to shadow volunteer mentors.
* In collaboration with the Volunteer Team, support the Doggy Day Out program, which includes scheduling one\-time volunteers, managing supplies, handing off dogs to volunteers and retrieving information from the adventure. If comfortable, regularly engage with and post on the PIN Volunteer Facebook group.

**NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS:** Excellent customer service record. Strong interpersonal skills. The ideal person for this position would be personable, outgoing, patient, professional, and able to get along well with a variety of people. Excellent written and oral communications skills. Strong organizational and project management skills. Creativity and ability to take initiative in starting new projects. Prior experience related to animal care, veterinary care and/or animal behavior. Comfortable working with a variety of domestic species (including dogs, cats, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters, rats, reptiles, etc.) and wild species (including squirrels, small birds, birds of prey, raccoons, etc.). Ability to work with minimal supervision and direction. Strong computer skills, familiarity with Microsoft applications, ability to quickly learn to use new programs.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**Prior work experience in a rescue or municipal animal service shelter setting. Understands and utilizes positive reinforcement. Fear Free Certified. Read, write and speak Spanish.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** Ability to spend the majority of shift completing desk\-based computer tasks. Ability to complete physical tasks with long periods of standing or walking. Ability to stand, bend, twist, stoop, push and pull,

new_jobs.title: Pre-Employment Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**


Crusoe's **Recruiting and People Operations** teams move fast \- and pre\-employment programs sit at the critical handoff point between an accepted offer and a confirmed start date. As the People Operations Manager, Pre\-Employment Programs, you will own the orchestration of our pre\-employment checks \- including background checks, drug and alcohol tests, immigration checks, etc \- ensuring each candidate moves smoothly and compliantly from offer to Day 1\.


You will manage the vendor relationship with our pre\-employment check vendor and act as the connective tissue between Recruiting and Onboarding Programs, translating today's ad hoc handoffs into a documented, auditable process with clear roles and responsibilities. This role also owns the administration of Crusoe's background screening and drug and alcohol testing programs, including DOT and non\-DOT populations, ensuring programs are compliant, well\-governed, and consistently executed as the company scales. This is a full\-time, onsite position based in San Francisco, CA, for someone who wants to build the operational backbone behind a high\-stakes, high\-visibility process.

 **What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Vendor Relationship Management:** Own the end\-to\-end relationship with Crusoe's background check and drug/alcohol testing vendor(s) \- service performance, escalations, contract renewals, and issue resolution.
* **Pre\-Employment Screening Orchestration:** Serve as the operational owner of every pre\-employment check, coordinating with Recruiting Operations on package selection, Immigration Operations for work authorization checks, and Onboarding Operations when start dates shift, and resolving exceptions before they delay a start date.
* **Drug \& Alcohol Testing Program Administration:** Oversee the administration of our pre\-employment and support the administration of the random, post\-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return\-to\-duty testing programs, including maintaining appropriate testing pools for DOT and non\-DOT populations.
* **Process Design \& Documentation:** Design and document the end\-to\-end pre\-employment process, including a clear RACI that defines roles and responsibilities across Recruiting, People Operations, and Onboarding.
* **Compliance \& Adjudication Partnership:** Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Employee Relations on adjudication decisions, job profile designation (safety\-sensitive, DOT, PHMSA), and FCRA\-compliant recordkeeping.
* **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Serve as the connective tissue between Recruiting and Onboarding, ensuring handoffs are seamless and no candidate falls through the cracks.
* **Training \& Enablement:** Build training, documentation, and communications for Recruiting, People Operations, Onboarding, and hiring managers on pre\-employment requirements and processes.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor turnaround times, error rates, and candidate experience data; identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and consistency as volume grows.

 **What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Pre\-Employment Program Expertise:** Experience administering background check and/or drug and alcohol testing programs, ideally within a high\-growth or regulated environment.
* **Vendor Management:** Proven ability to manage external vendor relationships, holding partners accountable to SLAs and resolving service issues.
* **Process Design:** A track record of designing and documenting end\-to\-end processes, including defining roles and responsibilities across cross\-functional teams.
* **Regulatory Fluency:** Working knowledge of FCRA and DOT/PHMSA screening and testing requirements, and how they apply to job profile designation.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Experience partnering with Recruiting, Onboarding, Compliance, Legal, and Employee Relations to deliver a consistent candidate and employee experience.
* **Systems Proficiency:** Comfort working within an ATS and HRIS (e.g. Ashby, Rippling) to track and manage screening statuses.
* **Operational Rigor:** Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple candidates and cases simultaneously without missing a deadline.
* **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience, with 5\+ years of experience in People Operations, Recruiting Operations, or a related compliance function.

 **Bonus Points**

* Prior experience supporting a DOT\-regulated workforce or other safety\-sensitive population.
* Experience building or significantly overhauling a pre\-employment or background screening program from the ground up.

 **Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs

IT Management Corporation (ITMC) is a technology solutions provider specializing in networking, communications, cloud, cybersecurity, and managed services. Since 2009, we've helped organizations modernize their technology environments, with a strong focus on State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) customers.


Learn more at ITMC.net.

 **Job Description**  

ITMC is seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to manage and grow a portfolio of existing SLED accounts. This role builds trusted customer relationships, drives retention, identifies expansion opportunities, and ensures customers get maximum value from their technology investments.


The ideal candidate combines account management skills with a consultative approach, serving as a strategic partner to school districts, government agencies, and other public sector organizations while collaborating with sales, engineering, operations, and leadership.

* Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of SLED accounts, building relationships with IT leaders, administrators, procurement teams, and key stakeholders.

* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful project delivery and support, acting as the voice of the customer.

* Partner with sales and engineering to build strategic account plans and technology roadmaps.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate with engineering, project management, support, and vendor partners on customer outcomes.
* Assist with vendor registrations and sales support activities as needed.
* Maintain accurate customer records and account documentation.
* Share customer feedback and market insights to help improve service offerings.

  

**Qualifications**  

* 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Executive, or Sales within a VAR, MSP, UCaaS, networking, cybersecurity, or technology solutions environment.
* Experience supporting public sector, government, or education customers preferred.
* Understanding of networking, cloud, cybersecurity, communications, or managed services solutions.
* Strong relationship\-building, communication, and presentation skills.
* Experience managing multiple accounts and competing priorities.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Core Competencies**

* Customer\-first mindset with strong business acumen and consultative problem\-solving.
* Ability to build trust and credibility with executive\-level stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and results\-oriented; adaptable in a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative team player with strong follow\-through and accountabilit

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Join ITMC?

* Growing technology company with a strong reputation in the SLED market.
* Work alongside experienced technology, sales, and engineering professionals.
* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.


All information is kept confidential per EEO guidelines.

* Experience building structured plans, managing dependencies, and coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups

**Preferred**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to create concise, executive\-ready narratives and presentations

new_jobs.title: Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
The Livermore Lab Foundation (LLF) is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization established in 2016 to advance scientific research and inspire the next generation of scientists and engineers to help ‘open the door’ to a better future for all. As a key partner to Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), a Department of Energy national security laboratory in Livermore, California, the Foundation raises philanthropic funds to support Lab research, student fellowships, and community engagement initiatives.

**Position Summary**

Reporting to the Executive Director, the Operations Associate will support the Foundation’s day\-to\-day office and administrative functions as they related to the organization’s financials, grants/contracts, human resources, information technology, development, and more. As a new role in the organization, the position requires a highly organized professional who can work independently while coordinating with team members in multiple locations. Because this position balances a variety of responsibilities, a high degree of flexibility, a professional attitude, and significant initiative and attention to detail are required. Our ideal candidate is familiar with business management best practices, is interested in working in the nonprofit sector and is committed to LLF’s mission. Note: this is a 40 hour per week, hybrid position with expectations of at least 3\-4 days per week in the Livermore office.

**Primary Responsibilities**

Key duties include but are not limited to:

*Administration* 

* Refine and maintain formal employment and administrative systems, policies, and internal procedures for all functions of the Foundation’s day\-to\-day operations. Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local laws and appropriate nonprofit standards.
* Support management of the Foundation’s customer relationship management (CRM) system (Neon donor database) to ensure that constituents, communications and gifts are properly documented and updated. This includes maintaining donor accounts and tracking gift records, supporting team in ensuring appropriate stewardship and communication, and coordination and execution of timely email and print correspondence.
* Manage general organizational renewals, document retention and organization. This includes insurance, membership and subscription renewals, invoices, and other legal and financial compliance requirements.
* Assist in preparation and processing of invoices, grant reports, and other organizational communications as needed.
* Support LLF Board meetings and committees (take minutes, track action items, write and send follow up reports).
* Provide general administrative support to the team and perform other duties as assigned by the Executive Director.

*Finance/Bookkeeping* 

* Support the creation of and monitor the organization’s annual operating and program budgets, including financial grant reporting.
* Support contract and grant management to ensure compliance with documentation and reporting.
* Prepare financial documents and summaries, including regular board communications and grant reports in coordination with the Foundation’s financial team, to accurately reflect the financial condition of the organization.
* Support all bookkeeping functions including A/R, A/P and payroll.
* Assist off\-site accountant in preparing for LLF’s audit and federal and state taxes and reports.

*General Office Operations* 

* Help design and implement an ongoing process for tracking grants and contracts, including research, proposal submissions, reporting, and billing/payment cycles in coordination with LLNL.
* Liaison with the Foundation’s IT consultant to ensure appropriate technology systems and controls are maintained throughout Foundation operations.
* Assist in planning and executing Foundation events and activities, including annual student showcase and donor cultivation and stewardship programs.
* Provide as\-needed on\-site facility management and operational support to the University of California Livermore Collaboration Center (UCLCC), where the LLF office is located, including on\-site assistance for building users and guests, meeting and special event support, coordination of building access, assistance with emergency procedures, backup administration of event calendaring and room reservations, and basic troubleshooting of UCLCC audiovisual systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least two years nonprofit or business management experience
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities, including demonstrated experience with office management, human resources and financial reporting
* Solid financial acumen with ability to prepare budget documents and support accounting and reporting processes
* Proficient in QuickBooks Online (minimum of two years preferred), Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, Dropbox, and Neon (or similar donor database software)
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills and ability to collaborate and correspond with staff, Board, consultants, donors and volunteers
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Available to work occasional evenings and possible weekends

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of nonprofit governance, compliance or financial best practices
* Experience with CRM database management
* Experience with contract and grant management
* Previous experience or demonstrated interest in science research or STEAM (Science, Technology, Education, Art and Math) fields

**Licensure and Other Requirements**

* Valid California driver’s license and automobile insurance (may require some travel within the Tri\-Valley region)
* Must reside in California and live a commutable distance from LLF office at the time of hire
* Background check will be required post\-offer in compliance with California state laws

**Compensation and Benefits**

### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have an opening for an **Associate Program Leader** for the Counterterrorism (CT) group within the International Assessments (IA) Program to lead a dynamic team developing and executing the work of the Laboratory in support of intelligence missions in foreign nuclear weapons programs and threats involving radiological or nuclear (R/N) terrorism, and R/N materials. You will serve as a key member of the IA Program leadership team responsible for addressing workforce needs, safety, security, technical quality, standards, and project management to enhance the Laboratory's contributions to national security. In addition, you will substantively oversee the CT group’s analytic portfolio. This position is in the IA Program within Global Security Principal Directorate’s Z Program.  

  

**In this role, you will**

* Serve as a member of the IA Program leadership team, influencing the development and implementation of institutional objectives and goals.
* Provide technical and analytical leadership to technical staff to develop and provide subject matter expertise and analysis of foreign nuclear weapons programs and threats involving radiological or nuclear (R/N) terrorism, and R/N materials for multiple government sponsors.
* Identify and pursue program development opportunities, develop an internal investment strategy and work with IA Program Leader, as well as leaders in Z and other Laboratory Programs and Directorates to identify and pursue collaborative projects.
* Formulate and execute short\-term and strategic goals for the program, including setting the program’s annual research agenda and producing highly advanced, finished intelligence analysis, reports, and briefings that meet intelligence community (IC) tradecraft standards.
* Provide project management oversight for the program’s analytic portfolio, including developing project execution plans and ensuring appropriate resource allocation, timelines, and review of the group’s deliverables.
* Assist in planning and direct activities for staffing of CT projects; manage program budget, allocate resources, determine qualification standards and attract, retain, recruit, and select staff with technical expertise.
* Lead performance management and career development activities for all members of the CT group, including conducting quarterly check\-in and regular 1:1 meetings, writing performance reviews, and providing input for matrix personnel. Develop, implement, and maintain a mentoring program for analysts and principal investigators to support the career development goals of all team members.
* Build, maintain, and enhance strong relationships with external and internal sponsors, customers, and stakeholders to ensure exquisite execution of projects and satisfaction of commitments.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Additional job responsibilities, at the SEL.5 Level**

* Develop innovative concepts and provide expert leadership, technical vision, and strategic planning for both analytic and scientific research and development.
* Present project accomplishments and meet customer expectations, as well as identify new opportunities, goals, and application areas by leading the development of proposals interacting with senior program management.
* Develop and implement new innovative analytical capabilities within the program and apply them against an expanding portfolio.
* Influence strategic decisions made by senior management and external customers at the national level.


### **Qualifications**


* This position requires an active DOE Q clearance at the time of hire and the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access.
* Master’s degree in physical science, nuclear physics, weapons design, engineering, political science or related discipline, or the equivalent combination of education and extensive related experience.
* Subject matter expert knowledge and experience in intelligence analysis of foreign nuclear weapons programs and nuclear proliferation with a demonstrated track record of intelligence community publications.
* Subject matter expert experience managing, leading, and supervising multidisciplinary teams to execute deliverables for external programmatic sponsors.
* Subject matter expert experience influencing and collaborating with partners and stakeholders to achieve programmatic objectives.
* Subject matter expert in strategizing and developing strategic planning efforts to meet short and long\-term mission deliverables.
* Subject matter expert knowledge of Intelligence Community (IC) needs and practices, including SCI security marking, intelligence oversight and compliance, and related security practices.
* Subject matter expert experience working in a classified environment with highly complex, multi\-agency security requirements with both classified and unclassified subject matter.
* Expert verbal and written communication skills necessary to effectively present, explain, and advise senior management and external sponsors and customers, including preparing and presenting proposals and reporting results.

new_jobs.title: Enhanced Care Management/ Lead Care Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Lead Care Manager (Community Health Advocate)**

*(Field\-Based — Assigned to Your Local Home County)*

**Company:** OverSightMD Inc.

**Hiring Locations:** Santa Clara County, Monterey County, Santa Cruz County, San Benito County, and Merced County

**Compensation:** Starting at $28\.00/hour

**Job Type:** Part\-Time *(High need for afternoon shifts: 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM)*; Full\-Time also available

**Benefits:** Health Insurance, 401(k) *(for full\-time employees)*

Note to Applicants: OverSightMD is hiring Care Managers across multiple Central California counties. You will be assigned to work primarily within the county where you currently live to build deep, authentic connections with your neighbors.**Turn Your Life Experience Into a Career That Matters**

Are you the person in your family who always takes grandma to her doctor’s appointments? Did you have to fight to get a friend or family member the care they needed? Have you navigated the challenges of housing instability, recovery, or re\-entering the community yourself?

OverSightMD is looking for **Lead Care Managers** to join our Enhanced Care Management (ECM) team. We are looking for people with "Lived Experience"—people who have walked a mile in the shoes of the members we serve.

If you are a natural advocate, a problem solver, and someone who genuinely loves to help others, we want to train you to be a professional Care Manager.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for "Community Champions." You might be a perfect fit if:

* **You are a Caregiver:** You have experience caring for aging parents, grandparents, or family members with disabilities. You know how hard it is to manage medications and appointments.
* **You are an Advocate:** You have navigated the healthcare system for yourself, a child, or a loved one. You know how to ask doctors the right questions.
* **You Have "Lived Experience":** You or a loved one have experienced homelessness, substance use recovery, the justice system, or mental health challenges. You understand the stigma and the barriers.
* **You Volunteer:** You spend time at food pantries, homeless shelters, church groups, or community events because you care about your neighbors.

**Required Skills**

* **Bilingual (Strongly Preferred):** Fluency in Spanish is highly desired to help us communicate directly with the communities we serve.
* **Tech\-Savvy:** You must have basic computer skills. You will be documenting your visits and member stories on a laptop/tablet.
* **Mobile \& Reliable:** You must have a reliable vehicle, a valid driver’s license, and auto insurance. This is a field\-based role—you will be visiting members in their homes, at shelters, or in the community *(mileage is paid!)*.

**What You Will Do**

As a Lead Care Manager, you are the bridge between the healthcare system and the real world. Your primary job is to build trust.

* **Build Relationships:** Visit members where they are—whether that’s a home, a shelter, or a coffee shop. Listen to their stories without judgment.
* **Advocate:** Go to doctor’s appointments with members to ensure they are heard and understood.
* **Connect to Resources:** Help members find housing support, food banks, transportation, or legal aid.
* **Transition Support:** Help members move safely from the hospital or a nursing facility back into their own homes.
* **Empower:** Teach members how to manage their own health, reminding them that they are capable and worthy of care.

**The People We Serve**

You will be working with local residents across **Santa Clara, Monterey, Santa Cruz, San Benito, and Merced counties** who simply need a helping hand to manage their health. Most of our members are everyday people struggling with chronic conditions who need support staying on top of doctor’s appointments, medications, and follow\-ups.

* **Families, Youth \& Seniors:** Helping aging parents stay independent at home or ensuring foster youth get the care they need.
* **Pregnant \& Postpartum Moms:** Supporting healthy pregnancies and helping new moms navigate the healthcare system.
* **Neighbors with Chronic Health Needs:** Helping people manage things like diabetes or heart disease so they can stay healthy and out of the hospital.
* **Community Members Seeking Stability:** Assisting those facing housing insecurity or other life challenges to connect with the resources they need to thrive.

**Why Work With OverSightMD?**

* **Meaningful Work:** This isn't just a job; it’s an opportunity to change the trajectory of someone’s life using the wisdom you’ve gained from your own experiences.
* **Training Provided:** We will teach you the technical parts of the job. We just need you to bring the empathy and the drive.
* **Competitive Pay:** Starting at $28\.00 an hour.
* **Flexible Schedules:** Morning and afternoon shifts available *(Afternoon shifts from 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM are highly preferred right now).*
* **Real Benefits:** We offer a 401(k) and Health Benefits for full\-time employees to ensure you and your family are taken care of.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief note telling us why you are passionate about this work. Tell us about your "lived experience"—we want to hear your story!

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: From $28\.00 per hour

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Please send with your resume a brief description, telling us why you are passionate about this work. Tell us about your "lived experience"—we want to hear your story.
* Sometimes people may be hesitant to accept help. How would you encourage someone to feel comfortable receiving support?
* How do you learn about local resources to help others?

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**CCEP Program Coordinator/Administrative Coordinator**
=======================================================


**Posting Number:** \#2162


**Position Title:** Program Coordinator


**Closing Date:** Until Filled


**Location:** Remote, USA

  


The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well\-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.



PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non\-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non\-Profit Times in a national search.

  


##### **POSITION SUMMARY**



The Public Health Institute (PHI) serves as the National Program Office (NPO) for the Pediatric Environmental Health Specialty Units (PEHSU), funded through the CDC. PHI, as the national program office, facilitates and amplifies the capacity of the PEHSU network to prevent/mitigate hazardous environmental exposures during fetal, childhood, and adolescent development, and the preconception period.



The Program Coordinator provides essential administrative, project management, financial, event, and communications support for the PEHSU’s Childhood Cancer and the Environment Program activities to ensure effective day\-to\-day operations. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, familiarity with web applications and social media, and the ability to manage multiple priorities. new_jobs.description:
**Position:** Full\-Time (W\-2\)  
**Location:** Remote, with travel as needed, up to 30%  
**Reports To:** Chief Customer Officer  
**Start Date:** Immediately

**The role**

You will be the primary leader for your assigned accounts and the voice of the client inside Enliven. You will coordinate analytics, negotiation, operations, and other specialists around client outcomes. Success means owning the relationship, the process, and the result, not personally performing every specialist task.

Generally speaking, over the course of a year, approximately 50% of this role will focus on account management, 25% on sales\-related activities, and 25% on RFP and sourcing leadership. The actual mix will change with the ebbs and flows of the business, and the number of RFPs will vary based on client timing, scope, and complexity. At times, account leadership will demand most of your attention. At other times, prospecting, industry representation, RFP activity, or business development will take priority. The right person will be energized by that variety and comfortable contributing wherever they can create the most value for clients and Enliven.

**About Enliven**

Enliven helps large organizations that purchase significant volumes of non\-alcoholic beverages generate significant cost savings and increased revenue through exclusive and semi\-exclusive beverage agreements and pouring rights. We help leaders negotiate their first or next beverage partnership, typically with Coca\-Cola, PepsiCo, or Keurig Dr Pepper, and optimize the resulting program to grow sales, reduce labor costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

We negotiate and manage best\-in\-class beverage partnerships for leading organizations across the restaurant, healthcare, entertainment, retail, and aviation industries.

**The opportunity**

Enliven is seeking a commercially minded Account Manager to inherit and lead a portfolio of approximately 5\-10 client relationships, grow those accounts, quarterback complex beverage sourcing and RFP work, and help generate new business.

This is an entrepreneurial role for someone who enjoys both serving clients and creating opportunities, and who can shift between those priorities as the needs of a growing small business change.

**What you’ll own**Client relationships, retention, and growth

* Take immediate ownership of a portfolio of approximately 5\-10 accounts, leading each relationship from onboarding and ongoing delivery through renewal and growth.
* Build trusted relationships across each client organization, including executive sponsors, day\-to\-day contacts, and other influential stakeholders.
* Maintain a clear account plan for every relationship, including health, commitments, priorities, value delivered, open issues, risks, renewal strategy, growth opportunities, and next steps.
* Make Enliven’s value visible through proactive communication, executive\-ready summaries, business reviews, recommendations, and consistent follow\-through.
* Identify retention, expansion, scope, and relationship risks early, recommend action, and escalate when the situation requires it.

RFPs, sourcing, and strategic partnerships

* Quarterback beverage RFPs and competitive sourcing engagements from strategy and timeline through evaluation, recommendation, award, and implementation.
* Translate client goals into clear internal priorities, deliverables, decisions, and deadlines.
* Coordinate analytics, negotiation, operations, and other specialists while respecting clear ownership, capacity constraints, and team work queues.
* Build productive beverage\-company relationships and lead communication about performance, commitments, opportunities, renewals, negotiations, and competitive processes.
* Drive measurable growth within existing accounts by improving contract compliance and increasing beverage volume through marketing and promotional activities aligned with available beverage\-company resources.
* Own follow\-through across complex engagements, surfacing resource needs, competing priorities, scope questions, and delivery risks early.

New business and market presence

* Develop qualified opportunities through relationships, referrals, industry connections, thoughtful outbound activity, conferences, and Enliven’s broader business\-development efforts.
* Represent Enliven credibly in the industries we serve, build early\-stage relationships, and help prospective clients understand the value of Enliven’s work.
* Advance prospects with persistence and sound judgment, maintain accurate pipeline activity and forecasts, and ask for the business.
* Contribute directly to both new\-logo revenue and growth within existing accounts.

Operating discipline and teamwork

* Maintain accurate CRM activity, account plans, forecasts, commitments, and next steps so priorities and decisions remain visible.
* Use good judgment about when to act independently, seek specialist input, involve other Enliven resources, or escalate to the Chief Customer Officer.
* Partner directly across Enliven’s two operating pillars without creating competing priorities or work queues.
* Adapt quickly as account service, sales, travel, and internal priorities ebb and flow.
* Step into the work that creates the most value for clients and Enliven while maintaining ownership of core account commitments.

**What success looks like**

* A healthy, well\-led portfolio with strong relationships, visible client value, proactive risk management, and clear renewal and growth plans.
* High retention and expansion, well\-run sourcing and RFP processes, and smooth awards and implementations.
* A consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities and meaningful new and expanded business closed.
* Clients experience one accountable relationship leader, even when the work involves multiple Enliven specialists.
* Increasing autonomy, strong commercial judgment, reliable cross\-functional leadership, and consistent follow\-through.

Thrive is a leading behavior change technology company founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016 with the mission to end the stress and burnout epidemic. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well\-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI\-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science\-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 125 organizations in over 140 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies.

* **Drive retention and growth.** Develop account strategies, identify opportunities to deepen partnerships, and lead renewal and expansion conversations in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
* **Champion the client internally.** Bring client feedback into product and roadmap discussions and partner with Sales, Legal, Security, and other teams to advance contracts, data agreements, and escalations.
